By comparing the angle error with the angle error threshold, the controller automatically switches between the two control modes to achieve the control purpose. Under the condition of no load, experiments were carried out on rehabilitation mechanical leg. The experimental results showed that the dual-mode control can reach the steady state faster than the classical PID control by about 3.2%, and the steady-state error of about 4.8% was reduced compared to the fuzzy control.

articleTitle: Experimental Testing and Performance Comparisons between V - and Z-shaped Electrothermal Microactuators
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This work presents comprehensive experimental studies on performance comparisons between V - and Z-shaped electrothermal microactuators. The V - and Z-shaped electrothermal microactuators are fabricated by depositing a copper layer on each side of SU-8 photoresist. The steady-state output displacement and dynamic responses of V - and Z-shaped actuators are compared based on experimental testing. In addition, a unique actuator with mixed V - and Z-shaped beams is designed and tested to further compare the force output capabilities of the V - and Z-shaped beams. Experimental data is acquired based on image processing, and a parallel spring model is proposed to analyze the experimental results. Comprehensive discussions are given to provide insights and guidance on the selection and design of the V - and Z-shaped electrothermal micoactuators.

articleTitle: An Improved VIBE Algorithm for Fast Suppression of Ghosts and Static Objects
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The initialization of VIBE algorithm leads to the problem of ghosts. Due to the update strategy of the original VIBE algorithm, the static object will be misjudged as the moving object for a long time. This paper presents an improved VIBE algorithm to suppress ghosts and static objects faster and more completely. First, using the original VIBE algorithm to detect the moving object, the static foreground in a specific region of a continuous multi frames is detected. Next, according to the variance of the static foreground of the current frame, ghosts and static objects are distinguished. Then the background pixels are replaced by using update strategy. The update strategy of the original VIBE is a random replacement for elements in sample set. While in this paper, we only replace elements that are judged as background pixels. This method is more objected, and can speed up the update process of background models. The experimental results show that the improved algorithm can suppress ghosts faster and more completely, and solve the problem of static objects to a certain extent.

articleTitle: A Teleoperation Framework of Hot Line Work Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: A teleoperation framework is proposed for hot line work robot (HL WR). Firstly, the design concept of the robotic system and the teleoperation framework are presented. Then, the related teleoperation technologies, including robotic arm trajectory control and impedance force control, manually operation methods with joystick/haptic device/3D space mouse, visual based automatic operation method and cooperative control method of dual armed manipulator are detailed introduced. At last, a preliminary teleoperation testbed in lab is setup and the manually operation test is conducted to verify some of the teleoperation technologies. Good performance is achieved and lays the foundation for further development of the HLWR system.

articleTitle: Development of the HALCON Software-based Harness Number Identification
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: With the wide application of video technology and infrared imaging technology in the mechanical manufacturing industry, some applications are given priority to the use of computer vision technology, and computers replace monitoring personnel for image understanding. At the same time, with the development of electronic technology in recent years, the wire harness is used as the physical carrier of electrical signals mainly for the transmission of energy and signals, and is widely used in aviation, automobiles, electrical appliances and other fields. Among them, the wire harness has a major impact on the operating status of the electrical and mechanical equipment, but in most cases, the background of the detection environment is complex, and the surface material of the wire set has affected the binding, cutting, assembly and other subsequent processes., especially for the identification of line number caused greater difficulties. This paper is based on the HALCON software development, after the online determination of the wire diameter of different types of the wire harness, according to the characteristics of different the wire harness diameters, the global threshold and the local threshold are divided, the positioning of the numbered area, correction of the line number deflection, and repair of character breaks are performed, and their features are extracted. Through experiments, the recognition of the line number character was successfully achieved, and a higher level of recognition accuracy was achieved, and the production efficiency was improved.

articleTitle: Study on Guidance Algorithm of Scene Matching based on Different Source Images for Cruise Missile
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Scene matching guidance based on different source images is one of the most difficult problems that land attack cruise missile faces at the stage of terminal guidance. Usually the reference images are provided by CCD optical equipment of reconnaissance satellite, and real-time images come from infrared seeker of missile, so reference images and real-time images differ extremely in image quality. If the conventional algorithm is applied for scene matching, the matching effect will be bad. So a kind of new scene matching algorithm based on different source images is studied in this paper. First of all, the different source images are preprocessed by the method of edge enhancement. Then the radial projection algorithm is used for coarse image matching. On the basis of coarse matching, the edge features of infrared images and visible images are extracted for fine image matching ulteriorly. With this method of two stages image matching from coarse matching to fine matching, the guidance accuracy of cruise missile is improved greatly, and the matching accuracy is higher when images are different source or rotated.

articleTitle: Saliency Detection Algorithm Based on Local Linear Constraint
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In order to separate a large amount of redundant information in image recognition, an image saliency detection algorithm based on local linear constraints is proposed. Based on the traditional method of reconstructing the error, the image is detected with the local constraint. The traditional method is only constructed based on the background codebook. At the same time, the foreground dictionary is constructed by single-scale segmentation, and the image reconstruction residual is calculated on our method. The error value of the image region is calculated, and the foreground and background dictionary are combined at the same time. Then we adapt the process and normalize the acquired foreground and background saliency maps. Finally we test our method on public databases such as ASD, SED1, SED2, and SOD. The experimental data shows that the proposed algorithm is effective in detecting significant targets of images on the three criteria of P-R curve, F-measure value, and MAE value.

articleTitle: Structure Design and Simulation Study of Dual Two-quadrant Coherent Tracking System in Free Space Optical Communication
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The free-space optical (FSO) communication has the advantages of high frequency, wide bandwidth and low cost, and has become a hot research topic in recent years. It has great potential in the field of broadband wireless communication, and it is one of the developing directions of the next generation optical communication technology. The free-space optical communication system mainly includes transmitting, receiving and acquisition, tracking, and pointing system, among which the ATP (Acquisition, Tracking, and Pointing) subsystem is one of the key technologies of free space optical communication. Accurate and efficient ATP technology is a necessary condition for Long-distance optical communication. In this paper, a coherent optical receiver terminal has been designed, and dual perpendicular mounted two-quadrant detector structure is developed for tracking in coherent free-space optical communication systems. The dual two-quadrant detector advantages are analyzed according to coherent optical detection theory, and the error compensation algorithm for dual two-quadrant detector is derived. The processing of data can be simplified by this structure. The kind of structure is low in complexity and has the ability to adjust after shock. The system of positioning accuracy and signal-to-noise ratio is improved, and the feasibility as well as superiority of this method are further proved by simulation.

articleTitle: Research Review on the Smart Distribution Grid
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: To accommodate more Distribution Generations and improve power supply reliability, the concept of Smart Distribution Grid has been raised. It is the research focus of the smart grid and ensuring reliable power and quality power supply. This paper covers the concept, significance, key technologies, development situation at home and abroad. As the new forms of the SDG, Self-Healing Control (SHC), micro grid (MG), and Advanced Distribution Automation (ADA) is analyzed and compared with each other. Finally, it introduces the trend and new technology in the development of smart distribution grid.

articleTitle: Real-time Electrical Simulation Inertia Detection Based on Savitzky-Golay Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In this paper, the method of improving the electrical inertia detection accuracy is studied. The influence of the braking torque and rotational speed on the electrical inertia fluctuation is analyzed respectively. Results show that speed signal is the main factor affecting the detection accuracy. The real-time electrical simulation inertia detection method based on Savitzky-Golay filtering algorithm is established by using C++ language. The electrical simulation inertia measured before and after the speed signal filtering processing, shows that even if the fluctuation amplitude of the angular deceleration speed is more than 100%, the electrical simulation inertia detection accuracy can also reach to 5%.

articleTitle: Research on Simulation of Improved Sliding Mode Variable Structure Control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Sliding mode variable structure control theory is a kind of control method deriving from the development of computer. It has unique and excellent robustness to the system parameter perturbation, external disturbance, system uncertainty and so on, and the algorithm is simple. In this thesis, compared with the traditional equal velocity trending law and traditional exponential velocity trending law, the chattering problem of sliding mode variable structure control system is improved. The results show that the advantages of the improved exponential velocity trending law in preventing and eliminating chatter are summarized, and a feasible control scheme is proposed, which has achieved good results in solving the chattering problem of variable structure control systems. It provides a feasible solution for simply and quickly solving system stability problems and improving system performance.

articleTitle: Research on Deskew Algorithm of Scanned Image
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: It is difficult to ensure that the scanned document will not be skewed due to the high speed scanning of the paper document by the mechanical feed or the document itself. This will not only affect the visual effects, but also seriously affect the accuracy and speed of subsequent processing. Therefore, this paper presents a Hough transform algorithm based on automatic scanning image correction and cropping, the first to determine whether the scanned image is a text or non-text image, the image preprocessing based on different types of scanned images of the image binarization, Compared with the traditional algorithm has a good anti-interference ability, can accurately detect the scan image skew angle.

articleTitle: Neural Network-based Adaptive Sliding Mode Control for Gyroelastic Body
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Gyroelastic body refers to a flexible structure with a cluster of angular momentum devices. The torques exerted by the angular momentum devices can be used for active vibration suppression. This paper addresses the vibration suppression of gyroelastic body in the presence of uncertainties and external disturbances. A neural network-based adaptive sliding mode controller (NNASMC), combining neural network (NN) approximation, adaptive technique and sliding mode technique, is designed to ensure the vibration suppression of the gyroelastic body. The stability of the proposed NNASMC is proved using Lyapunov theory. Simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed controller.

articleTitle: Design of Portable Transcranial Micro Current Depression Therapeutic Instrument
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Transcranial micro current therapy is a technology that directly introduces the action of tiny currents on the brain by electrodes placed on the earlobe. Through the stimulation of the micro current, it can increase the alpha brain wave activity and increase the concentration of the neurotransmitter that regulates the mood. It is used in the treatment of mental diseases such as depression, anxiety, insomnia and so on. A stimulator using transcranial micro current stimulation therapy is designed, and a main control chip is used to control the constant current generator circuit. It is consistent with bipolar constant micro current required for transcranial micro current stimulation. It effectively induced the alpha brain wave which made the mood stable, and enhanced the detected alpha brain wave.

articleTitle: Error Estimation of Circular Arc Interpolation Cutter Path Due to NC Servo Characteristic of Machining Center
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: From MC users' point of view, this paper proposes a practical approach to estimate trajectory error of circular arc interpolation cutter path produced by the NC servo characteristic for a target MC. For circular arc segment motion, a simple and convenient Ace/Dec procedure model only containing two parameters whose value is necessary to be decided by experiment is presented, together with identification experiment results. Furthermore, based on the model, the outline of a simulation method is explained to calculate actual trajectory of command cutter path. The comparison results of the measured and simulated trajectory with the profile error of workpiece machined under the same motion conditions sufficiently demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Registration of Infrared and Visible Image Based on OpenCV
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Registration of multi-sensor data is an important prerequisite for multimodal image processing such as image fusion and splicing. Due to the different imaging principles of infrared and visible images, the information of the images with the same field of view at the same time is very different, which brings great difficulties to the registration of infrared and visible images. In this paper, a novel registration algorithm of infrared and visible image based on morphological edge detection is proposed. The algorithm firstly performs a series of morphological operations based on the multi-directional structure elements on infrared and visible images to obtain the edge images of them. Then, the feature points of the two edge images are detected respectively by SURF algorithm. And the registration of the feature points is performed by using the nearest neighbor distance ratio. Finally, the RANSAC algorithm is used to eliminate false matches and obtain the final matching image. Experiment shows that the novel registration algorithm of infrared and visible image proposed in this paper can obtain more correct matching points and achieve higher accuracy and better effect in the registration.

Author Keywords: The Nearest Neighbor Distance Ratio Method

articleTitle: Feature Points Extraction and Matching Based on Improved Surf Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Speed up Robust Features (SURF) algorithm is an effective feature point extraction algorithm and its high efficiency and high stability are superior to similar algorithms, so it is widely used in image feature point extraction. However, due to the shortcomings of the SURF algorithm itself, it is easy to produce a mismatch phenomenon when performing feature point matching. When the image to be matched and the template image are quite different, the mismatch phenomenon is particularly obvious. In order to eliminate the mismatch, this paper improves the SURF algorithm by adding the RANSAC algorithm that eliminates the mismatched points. Experimental results show that the improved SURF algorithm can effectively eliminate false matching points.

articleTitle: Elimination Method of Master-Slave Jitter for Laparoscope Arm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper presents the jitter elimination method of master-slave control of laparoscope arm, and the driving torque of active joints before and after jitter elimination was compared. Two-time jitter elimination are performed in master-slave control process. The two-time jitter elimination is the position increment for the master manipulator and the joint rotation angle of the slave manipulator. Two different jitters were defined, namely normal jitter and abnormal jitter. Two sets of separate jitter trajectories were captured by using the master manipulator. Simulation analysis of jitter elimination method was performed with two trajectories. Lastly, virtual surgical system for the master-slave control of laparoscope arm was established. Simulation verification of jitter elimination method through virtual system was performed. The proposed jitter elimination method will provide the basis of the master-slave control.

articleTitle: Structure Design and Dynamic Characteristic Analysis of Vibration Fixture
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: According to the practice experience of vibration test, this article proposes the basic requirements for the function and design of the vibration test fixture and the problems that should be paid attention to in the production process; In terms of a space-loaded vibration test fixture, for example, this article take a detailed description of the fixture design, specific parameter design, and structural design and propose a method for detecting the dynamic characteristics of the fixture, and explain the method and principle of the test. The dynamic characteristics of the fixture are tested using a vibration table and a B&K data acquisition system to determine that the fixture meets the requirements of the vibration test and a method is proposed, which is of great significance to the vibration test signal processing.

articleTitle: Model-Reference Scheduling and Control Co-design with Two Paths
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: There have been growing concerns in networked control system with communication constraints. In the paper, a novel scheduling strategy, model-reference scheduling scheme, is proposed for dealing with the distribution of the network resource for the case that network exists not only in forward path but also in feedback path. The states and the control signals gain the access to the network by computing the difference between the real system and the ideal one. The stability analysis and the control and scheduling co-design are given by formulating the problem as a linear equality equation. The proposed strategy is demonstrated through a simple simulation.

articleTitle: For Prostate MRI Segmentation: A Prior-shape-based Level Set Model Combined with Gradient and Regional Information
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The contour extraction of prostate in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) plays a significant role in clinical diagnosis and related medical research. We propose a level set model, which incorporates shape priors and the gradient information of the image into C-V model which was submitted by Chan T F and Vese L for prostate MRI segmentation, and can segment the prostate contour in MRI with high precision. In our model, prior shape information is used as the external force, and the regional information as well as gradient information is used as internal force to drive curve evolution. Then the evolution curve is modified with the information of the image itself under the constraint of prior shape. Due to the addition of local gradient information, this method can better deal with the situation when there only exists small gray-level difference between the background and target area of medical image. Meanwhile, the accuracy and robustness of segmentation are improved. Finally, the experimental results and quantitative analysis show that the level set algorithm with priori shape information can adapt to different forms of the prostate better, and the addition of gradient information avoids the situation that traditional CV model unable to process the images with intensity inhomogeneity, which demonstrate the potential of the approach proposed in the prostate MRI segmentation.

articleTitle: Control Method of Reactive Power Sharing for Islanding Microgrid with Multiple Converters
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The islanding mode mircrogrid mostly constructed by multiple converters. Due to the different location, the converters reactive power sharing results always deviate from the set value, which reduced the microgrid stability. In this paper, the cause of reactive power sharing error is firstly analyzed. Based on the hierarchical control method, a reactive power sharing error compensate method is proposed. By using the control method, the reactive power of microgrid can be shared reasonably, and the stability of microgrid system can be improved. Finally, the proposed control method is verified by experiments, and the results show that the proposed control method is effective and feasible.

articleTitle: Finite-time Stability Analysis of Linear Time-varying Systems: A Numerical Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Under the perspective of numerical computation, this paper investigates the finite-time stability (FTS) of continuous linear time-varying (LTV) systems when all its initial values are confined within a given polyhedral set while all its states are confined within a given ellipsoidal set. First, by solving a certain function optimization problem, the paper proposes a necessary and sufficient condition to guarantee the FTS of continuous LTV systems. Then, by utilizing the Lipschitz continuity of a certain function, two sufficient conditions to verify the FTS and finite-time instability of continuous LTV systems are proposed under the perspective of numerical computation, respectively. Furthermore, a novel numerical algorithm for analyzing the FTS of continuous LTV systems is deigned by converting a certain function optimization problem into a corresponding quadratic programming. Finally, a numerical example is given to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Accurate and Efficient Positioning of Ground Based Telescope Using Tracking Differentiator with an Adaptive Parameter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: An accurate and efficient positioning method for the ground based telescope has been proposed in this paper. As the inner control loop, the speed loop can reject the total disturbance timely using a 2nd order extended state observer (ESO). Then the position loop can be easily approximated to be an I type system using the proportional controller. In order to mediate the contradiction between the speediness and overshoot in the position loop, a tracking differentiator with an adaptive parameter (ATD) has been proposed to give the transitional process for the position loop and the speed feed forward information for the speed control loop. Compared with the existing methods, the proposed ATD can easily provide a smooth position transitional process with the speed and acceleration limits which is more consistent with the response ability of the physical system. It is concluded that the proposed control algorithm displays a well control performance in a large range of position step responses of the telescope.

articleTitle: Structure Design and Analysis of Reconfigurable Fixture Robot Based on the Auto-body Panels
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The fixture is an important equipment, and is widely used in the auto-body panels to be assembled and welded. However, most fixtures, which installed on the production lines, are special to make the production cost higher and the production efficiency lower. Therefore, the reconfigurability of the fixture becomes a key factor that effects the production efficiency of automobiles. To handle the above problems, the new reconfigurable fixture robot is proposed in this paper, which can meet the handing, assembling and welding requirements of different automobile's sheet parts on the automobile production lines. First, the three-dimensional model and the kinematic equations of the proposed reconfigurable fixture robot are established. Then, the working space of the reconfigurable fixture robot is also obtained. Finally, the modal analysis of the reconfigurable fixture robot is performed to determine the cause of resonances. Reconfigurable fixture robots are capable of gripping the auto-body panels with the different radii of curvature, which can also meet the work scopes on the production lines.

articleTitle: Proposal of New Rotary Swaging Automation Process using 6 Step Creativity of TRIZ
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Rotary swaging process is a method of forging automotive drive shafts, which has process excellence such as high accuracy, high quality, and productivity improvement of products. In this paper, in order to improve the efficiency and productivity of the rotary swaging automation process, a new 2-hammer forging method will be proposed by applying 6 step creativity of TRIZ(6SC). We will simplify the materials and hammers for high accuracy of comparative analysis of existing (3-hammer forging) and proposed (2-hammer forging) methods under the same force and boundary conditions and then performed 3D modeling by SolidWorks®. And we will analyze the simulations for the 3-hammer forging method and the 2-hammer forging method using ANSYS, an analysis software tool. Finally, we will evaluate the roundness of the shaft forged by each method through ANSYS. The proposed method and the existing method will be shown to have the same strain tendency and good roundness by the simulations. Thus the proposed 2-hammer forging method can reduce the production cost (power consumption, installation cost, installation space) and improve the efficiency in the automation process by reducing the power source, compared to the 3-hammer forging method.

articleTitle: Autonomous Mobile Robot Based on Differential Global Positioning System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The autonomous mobile robots have self perception, decision making and execution function with larger working space compare with the traditional industrial robots, which are widely used for the situation of medical monitoring, military reconnaissance, substation inspection and etc. It has the advantages of saving human resources, avoiding dangerous situations and more efficient. In order to implement Autonomous Mobile, a centimeter-level high-precision system are designed based on Differential GPS. A new algorithm are mainly introduced which is to confirm the position of the mobile robot with single high precision GPS and without compass.

articleTitle: Binocular Vision Location with Swing Compensation Based on Fisheye Lens
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In the field of marine monitoring, the monitoring equipment is prone to swing and the positioning accuracy is significantly reduced because of the complicated weather conditions at sea and the swaying of ships. In addition, marine surveillance requires a wide range of perspectives, traditional cameras are difficult to meet the perspective requirements. In view of the above problems, this paper presents a binocular fisheye visual positioning method with added swing compensation. First of all, under Matlab and OpenCV, the camera is calibrated using an improved algorithm., then the system's image processing module correct and process the image, and finally calculate the target's physical coordinates through tilt compensation. Experimental results show that the above method can be achieved, and the positioning accuracy is high, the error is less than 5%.

Author Keywords: Machine vision. Location. Swing compensation. Camera calibration. Trajectory capture

articleTitle: Research on Low Energy Consumption Attitude of Foot Bionic Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: By studying the relation of the attitude of robot and its energy consumption, a statics based method to obtain the low-energy attitude of robot is proposed, which realizes decreasing the energy consumption and increasing the battery life by adjusting its attitude in the horizontal environment. The method takes the low-speed hexapod bionic robot as the research object. Firstly, we obtain the output torque of each joint of leg through the statics analysis, and establish the energy consumption model of the robot. Considering the flexibility of the robot, we then introduce the performance index of the maximum step-length, and establish the multi-objective function based on the energy consumption and the maximum step-length. Finally, we derive the low-energy attitude of the robot by matlab simulation. The energy consumption experiment is carried out with the physical prototype to verify the validity of the method.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Space Docking Mechanism for On-orbit Assembly with Application to Space Telescopes
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The robotics servicing on-orbit especially for assembly on orbit will play significant role in future space task. This paper presents a small docking mechanism (DM) for space on-orbit assembly with applications to space telescopes. The detail design of DM is introduced and for safety, the main components are analyzed by limit finite element method (FEM). In order to realize the docking process, the visual capturing method based on the object identification technology is studied. Finally, the docking experiment is performed and the test results demonstrate that the object identification system can successfully realize the docking.

articleTitle: Object Grasping Under Shape Uncertainty Using Linear Combination of Two Kernel Functions
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: A tricky problem in robotics is how to deal with shape uncertainty in object grasping. This paper presents a new grasping planning algorithm using gaussian process (GP) for 2-finger adaptive gripper which could explicitly calculate the shape uncertainty of 3D objects. In our algorithm, we used the linear combination of two different kernel functions. And our experiments confirmed that this algorithm could complete robust grasping tasks under various constraints. The kernel function of linear combination has a wide adaptability to surface estimation. Particularly, we are the first to analyze the relationship between the impact factor (IF) of kernel function and the shape uncertainty of target objects. Our work proved that a optimal IF could reduce shape uncertainty as much as possible.

articleTitle: Application of Dynamic Vibration Absorber in Torsional Vibration Optimization of Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Torsional vibration is an important form of vibration of vehicle driveline, which can give rise to a variety of complex vibration and noise problems. In order to study the effect of torsional vibration of a driving system on the Front-engine Rear-drive(FR) vehicle, the model of the vehicle transmission system is established to describe the torsional vibration. In order to weaken the torsional vibration of the transmission system on the natural frequency, a dynamic vibration absorber is added to the drive system model. The results show that the dynamic vibration absorber has a great effect on the optimization of torsional vibration of transmission system, and that the dynamic vibration absorber can effectively reduce torsional resonance at certain frequencies.

articleTitle: A Study on Outlet Schemes of Indoor Substation based on AGA-AHP Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: With the limited urban land resources and people's high demand for living environment, the construction of urban substation is being increasingly denser and miniaturized indoor substation is being widely used. The outlet of substation is closely related to land area, so this paper proposes a new outlet scheme named positive and negative triangle outlet, based on common ways of outlet, to reduce the land area of substation. In order to compare the advantages of this outlet scheme with that of other outlet schemes under different indicators, AGA-AHP (Accelerating Genetic Algorithm Analytic Hierarchy Process) are used to perform quantitative evaluation for weight of various outlet schemes in electricity environmental protection, difficulty of installation, operation and maintenance, distribution cost, and land area, as well as its sub-indicators, and determine the optimal outlet scheme that meets the requirements. According to the actual situation of the project, outlet model of indoor substation is built by AGA-AHP algorithms, and judgment matrix is established by related experts. The algorithms can realize the quantification of qualitative indicators and the output of the optimal outlet scheme, so as to provide some reference to the construction of substation.

articleTitle: Robust Coordinated Formation Control of Multiple Vessels with Disturbance and Time Delay
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: When considering disturbance, the coordinated formation control of multiple vessels is studied. And a coordinated formation control approach is proposed. And a disturbance estimator is used to estimating the disturbance. Moreover, the undirected communication topology is constructed to represent the relationvessel of vessels. Meanwhile, the stability of the disturbance estimator and the coordinated formation controller are proved by the Lyapunov theory. Finally, four marine vessels with unknown time-variant disturbance and communication delay are simulated by computer simulation tests. It is shown that the proposed control strategy can solve the coordinated of multiple vessels.

articleTitle: Influence of Subdivision Error of Encoder on Speed Stability of Telescopes
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: High-resolution encoders are the most used angular transducer for ground-based large aperture telescope. High-resolution encoders are realized by electronic subdivision. In order to analyze the effect of the subdivision error on the speed stability of the telescope, a differential velocity measurement equation with subdivision error was established. Based on the Fourier analysis method, the influence of the subdivision error on the velocity measurement was analyzed from the amplitude and frequency characteristics, and the results of the analysis were verified by experimental results. Finally, the influence of subdivision error on the speed stability of servo system was analyzed by simulation. The research results can provide theoretical basis for control system performance evaluation and error analysis, as well as control system design.

articleTitle: Research on Aerial Image Splicing Technology of UAV
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: During the inspection process of transmission line using UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle), the visible light image obtained by the drone is stitched to obtain a panoramic view of the transmission line inspection area, which can be used as a base map for power inspection, thus providing data support for power channel environmental monitoring. However, in practical tests, due to the influence of cloud cover and non-uniform light distribution, shadows will be left on the generated splicing images, which will affect the image recognition. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes an image homogenization algorithm based on gray histograms, and uses this algorithm to process the stitched images. The experimental results show that the image splicing quality processed by the algorithm is better than the image processed by the fade-in and fade-out method. That is to say the method mentioned in this title has a good application prospect in the field of image mosaic based on UAV.

articleTitle: Research on Bidirectional Macro-Micro Assembly Technology Accuracy Based on 3-UPU Parallel Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The accuracy question for macro-micro assembly technology is essential for the design of bidirectional macro-micro assembly. The paper presents some new ideas that are different from the traditional design. A complex motion is decomposed into two simple motions. One (named assembling part) of the two assembled objects is fixed on the moving 3-UPU parallel mechanism (3 represents three degrees of freedom, U represents the hook pair, P represents the moving pair), and the other (named assembled part) is fixed on the rotating 3-UPU PM (parallel mechanism). By macro-micro motion of the PM, both assembling part and assembled part are assembled in three-dimensional space. By the design, both the mechanism and its motion control are simplified. Further more, both the kinematics analysis and accuracy simulation analysis of the 3-UPU PM are discussed. In order to improve the assembly accuracy, the kinematics analysis and simulation accuracy analysis for PM is an essential part of the design. And with the decrease of structure parameters error, the moving platform center accuracy will gradually be improved. Compared with the structure parameters error for PM, the centre moving error of the moving platform is smaller. In a certain extent, there is coupling error rather than the accumulation error for PM. By the analysis of hook pair error, the factors that affect the accuracy of the PM are found. And it provides theoretical design basis for the application of the PM in the macro-micro assembly technology.

articleTitle: Brain Activation Neuronal Substrates of Nonword Priming Effect: An tMRI Study
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: We investigated changes in the behavioral performance and brain activities associated with nonword priming in a Non Word Stem Completion (NWSC) task in Japanese in order to compare the result to our pilot study of word priming. In the behavioral results, we found obvious facilitatory effects in subject' s performance. Averaged reaction time in nonword priming-condition was 3103ms, while that of nonword nonpriming-condition was 5037ms In the fMRI results, the same tasks were performed by the block-design experimental paradigm without any overt response in MRI scanner. As a result, we found the activations in the bilateral middle and inferior frontal gyrus with right hemispheric prevalence, the superior and inferior parietal gyrus, and the supplementary motor area. These results may suggest that the facilitatory effects observed in WSC-test include implicit memory access and the induced attention after successful retrieval.

articleTitle: Infrared Dual-band Point Target Detection Based on Gradient Convolution Template and CFAR Criterion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper proposes a new dual-band point target detection method based on gradient convolution template and constant false alarm rate (CFAR) criterion. First, we analyze the single-band target detection theory, and then the dual-band detection model is derived according to the AND fusion rule. The threshold signal-to-noise ratio (TNR) is constantly adjusted to obtain the optimal fused probability of detection. Next, the gradient convolution template is employed to suppress complex background. The candidate points are obtained after the CFAR criterion under dual-band model. And finally the point target is successfully detected out through the data fusion correlation of two channels. The simulation and experimental results prove that the proposed dual-band detection method has a good performance to suppress complex background, and the algorithm is simple which meets the requirements of real-time for engineering.

articleTitle: Design and Research of Point Absorber Wave Power Converter
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on the feature that Wave Power Converter has poor power quality, and combines with the technology of wave power converter now. A wave power controller based on a point absorber Wave Power Converter is designed. The controller is mainly composed of three-phase bridge rectifier and Buck-Boost chopper circuit and it takes respective measures to solve unstable three-phase voltage of the Wave Power Converter as it seeks to make it become a stable direct current. A large number of simulation experiments on the land show that the controller is feasible, which builds the theoretical and experimental foundations for the practical application of point absorber Wave Power Converter. It also provides a solution to the problem of poor quality of Wave Power Converter.

articleTitle: A Reconfigurable Virtual Modeling Method for Robot Simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Robot simulation is an effective tool in evaluating the performance of robot. In traditional simulation, virtual models of robots are usually determined in advance. To enhance the flexibility and versatility of the simulation, a reconfigurable virtual modeling method for robot simulation is proposed in this paper. Reconfiguration includes addition, removal, and transformation of virtual models, realized with a C++ container. Finally, the reconfiguration simulation result for the typical space manipulator task indicates the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Signal Recognition Method of X-ray Pulsar Based on Instantaneous Amplitude Feature
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The X-ray pulsar signal recognition method based on instantaneous amplitude feature is proposed in this paper. The instantaneous amplitude of the X-ray pulsar signal after Hilbert transform is the main feature of the signal, and the signal recognition algorithm based on the minimum distance of the eigenvector is designed. In the simulation experiment, the feature samples of the pulsar navigation database are constructed. The results show that the proposed X-ray pulsar signal recognition algorithm is effective, which has the advantages of high reliability and fast recognition speed.

articleTitle: Research on Harmonic Detection Algorithm Based on Atomic Sparse Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: With the development of power grids, the access of non-linear loads such as uninterruptible power system (UPS), switching power supplies, rectifiers, frequency converters, inverters, etc., fundamental wave currents are prone to distortion and harmonics. Harmonic detection and decomposition are the preconditions for harmonic control. In this paper, the atomic sparse decomposition method is studied for power system harmonic detection problems. Based on the overcomplete sine quantity atomic library, the optimized matching pursuit algorithm is used to analyze the signal. Gradually decompose. This paper elaborates on the four aspects of the construction of the atomic library, the implementation of the algorithm, the complexity of the algorithm and the detection performance of the algorithm, and compares it with the ip-iq detection method in the instantaneous reactive power theory to verify that the algorithm is effective and superior in harmonic detection.

articleTitle: Double Axes Equal-Distance Projection
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Map projection is the key factor for robot navigation and lots of similar applications. For tackling with this challenging and imperative issue, a novel high speed and accuracy map projection algorithm named double axes equal-distance projection is elaborated. The algorithm adopted the equal-distance projection to two axis which is benefit for the accuracy and speed-up the calculation in the small-scale. Some experiments are carried out and some promising results are obtained. Based on an average 1.66 times faster and 9.5% higher accuracy than classic Gauss-Kruger projection algorithm, the double axes equal-distance projection algorithm presented in this paper will be widely employed.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Digital Sine Wave Inverter Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: A scheme of digital inverter power supply system is given in this paper. The system input 36VDC, through the Boost circuit, the single-phase inverter turns DC into high frequency alternating current, then the high frequency transformer is isolated by the high frequency transformer, and the high frequency part is filtered through the low pass filter, and the sine wave alternating current of 220VAC 50Hz is obtained. With STM32F103VCT6 as the system controller, through the software programming, through the Boost circuit, the output voltage and current double closed loop PWM soft switch control is carried out, and the system integration is completed. The experimental results show that the system meets the design requirements and the system design is feasible.

articleTitle: An optical system angle measurement accuracy detection method in lattice scanning form
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The measurement accuracy of the angle is one of the important technical index of the optical system. The detection method for angular measurement accuracy with the traditional electronic theodolite has the less measurement data and single scanning direction, which leads to inaccurate measurements. An improved detection method is proposed: lattice scanning form is used to detect the angle accuracy of the optical system. By analysing theoretical measurement model of the optical system and the conversion relationship between the target imaging position and the ideal imaging position, the method for measuring angular accuracy of the optical system is obtained. The experimental results show that the accuracy of this method reaches 0.1urad and the measured angular accuracy of the optical system is improved by 0.015mrad. The measurement method has important application value, which can be widely used in the military field, commercial and medical fields.

articleTitle: Normalized Correlation-Based Levinson Method for spectrum estimation in alpha Noise
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Electromagnetic spectrum estimation in alpha noise is an important research problem in Cognitive radio and radar systems. Due to their inherent nonlinearity, the existing all kinds of fractional lower order moment methods which are suitable for the alpha stable distribution signal processing cannot be used to solve the problem of the spectrum estimation in alpha noise. Since the normalized correlation function of alpha stable distribution process exist, the linear calculation property of the normalized correlation function determined that it is suitable for solving the parameterized spectrum estimation problems in alpha noise. The proposed normalized correlation function based Levinson spectrum estimation method fully proved this point.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation for Fifteen-phase Asynchronous Motor of Ship Electric Propulsion
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: A fifteen-phase asynchronous motor used for ship electric propulsion is studied. Firstly, the mathematical model of the fifteen-phase asynchronous motor is deduced and the simulation model is established. Then on the basis of the fifteen-phase asynchronous motor, vector control strategy according to the rotor flux oriented is designed. A fuzzy PID controller combining fuzzy control theory with traditional PID controller is applied to the fifteen-phase asynchronous motor speed control system. Finally combined with the MATLAB / Simulink software, simulation results show that fuzzy PID controller is significantly better than the traditional PID controller, with no overshoot, fast response and other characteristics. The feasibility of the control method used is verified.

articleTitle: Modeling and Control of an Electric Load Simulator
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper proposes an electric load simulator driving by electromagnetic actuator. Its function is to act desired load force on exhaust valve under laboratory conditions. The structure of the electric load simulator is designed to exert load force to the exhaust valve during opening process. The simulation model of the electric load simulator is established based on mathematical equations. PID algorithm is applied as the controller to reproduce gas force under different operating conditions. Simulation results verify that the proposed load system and controller can meet performance requirements and satisfy robust stability when ideal load force varies.

articleTitle: Design of Temperature Intelligent Control System based on Transcranial Micro Current Depression Therapeutic Instrument
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The temperature control system designed is mainly based on microcontroller-AT89S52, using sub-PID control algorithm, to achieve accurate temperature measurement and control. This system is mainly composed of temperature sensor, signal conversion and conditioning circuits, A / D module, micro-controller, D / A module, temperature buttons circuit, data display module, thyristor trigger circuit, optical isolators, crystal Gateway tube drive circuit and implementation agencies. This paper describes the hardware design of temperature control system and software realization method in detail. The test results show the temperature control system designed can achieve a more accurate measurement of temperature and runs stably. The technology adopted in the system is practical and worthy of market.

articleTitle: Heading Attitude Drifts Controlled by the Angular Accelerations Instead of Using Magnetometers
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: To reduce the Euler angular drift caused by the gyroscopes bias in zero-drift, the IMU sensors of the integrated accelerometers and gyroscopes was needing to work with either magnetometer, GNSS, or odometer and so on to revise Euler angle drift in the attitude estimation. Nevertheless, these methods may not work well in some there are the alternated electro-magnetic field or GNSS-denied in the IMU working environment. In detailed analyses, although the random played main roles in the gyroscope drifts, the gyroscope drifts had surely related the angular acceleration of IMU based on the estimating correlation of the angular accelerations of the gyroscopes and Euler angles. In the zero-drift experiment, the angular errors and angular acceleration errors both refilled to cancel the residual of the gyroscope bias. Thus, the second PID loop working on the renewable quaternion was designed principally to compensate the gyroscope bias errors through the balanced the angular acceleration errors of the gyroscopes and the Euler angles. The designing double closed loop algorithm shows the Euler angle drifts rotating in a fixed point have been efficiently improved several times comparing to the angular drifts measured by the complementary filter method. Thus, instead of using magnetometers, the experiment provides a new way to use IMU technology in the magnetic or GPS-denied environment. It is expectable that MEMS IMU could find more applications in the future.

articleTitle: Application of Catastrophe Theory in Gas Load Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Aiming at the prediction of gas load (city gas daily load), an application of catastrophe theory in gas load forecasting is put forward. Based on the catastrophe theory, we take gas load as state variables, the daily temperature, city population as control variables, a cusp catastrophe model of gas load forecasting is established. The model parameters are identified by using the least squares method based on the combination of computer technology. Then by the potential function, mutation manifold and odd point sets, the bifurcation set is obtained and the control parameters of mutation region are obtained. Then we carry on the forecast of gas load error analysis. The experimental results show that the method according to the temperature and population data can predict the gas load well.

articleTitle: A Water-Cooling Eletrome on Reducing Tissue Thermal Damage
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The increase of tissue temperature in monopolar electrome electrosurgery will damage the tissue inevitably. A water-cooling electrome is proposed to minimize tissue thermal damage. The coolant pours to the surgical tissue interface from the water-cooling electrome tip and takes away extra tissue heat. Consequently, the tissue damage decreases. A water-cooling electrome prototype is designed and comparative experiments with ordinary electrome are conducted. The experimental results show that the water-cooling electrome reduces the tissue damage at least 100 um compared with the ordinary electrome at the same output power. When the electrome power reaches 60 W, the average thermal lesion width of water-cooling electrome compared with that of ordinary electrome decreases 23.2%. The experiment results show that the water-cooling electrome is feasible.

articleTitle: 2GHz PLL Frequency Synthesize
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper mainly introduces the design, debugging and testing for 2GHz PLL frequency synthesizer, which applied to radar microwave module. The frequency synthesizer adopts the principle of phase-locked, the core component is LMX2430 which is integrated Low-power frequency synthesizer with a high-speed dual-mode front divider. The system equipped with a low noise operational amplifier LM6211 and a high-performance voltage-control oscillator SM2100. The frequency of the 16MHz crystal is selected as the reference frequency of the phase-locked loop. Finally, the frequency synthesizer is tested experimentally and the result achieved the design goal.

articleTitle: A Flexure-Based 3-PRPS Parallel Micro-/Nanopositioning System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: A six-DOF positioning mechanism was proposed in the paper. The mechanism adopts a 3-PRPS configuration and has three parallel limbs, which are distributed in parallel along the circumference of the output platform. To increase the mechanism output linearity and reduce the resolution requirement on actuators, a lever displacement reduction mechanism was exploited to satisfy the demands. The compliance parameterized model of the mechanism was established by using the compliance matrix method(CMM) and the output compliance of the mechanism was analytically calculated to be 8.479e-08m/N. The established model was verified by the finite element analysis(FEA) of ANSYS software package. The FEA result was 6.965e-08m/N. The CMM and FEA results have a model deviation of 21.74%. The output platform can bear the maximum x-axis load of 600N according to the FEA results. To verify the mechanism performance, a prototype was created and a stroke test experiment was conducted. The results show that the stroke is more than ±40μm × ±40μm × ±30μm × ±200μrad × ±200μrad × ±300μrad. The development micro-/nanopositioning platform is effective and expected to be applied to the six-DOF spatial positioning.

articleTitle: Non-contact Electromagnetic Induction Coagulation Detection Device
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Coagulation detection is a vital check item for patients undergoing surgery, and those with immunological disease and cardiovascular disease in clinic. Exploring the dynamic detection of the whole coagulation process has long been the research hotspot of experts and scholars. This study had proposed a novel electromagnetic type coagulation detector, which used the round and leaf spring as the middle spring support, with dynamic testing sensor technology of coagulation in vitro as the research objective. The vibration system constituted by support spring and electromagnetic induction device was theoretically analyzed through dynamic modeling of sensor. We conducted modal analysis and harmonic response analysis on the spring support group using finite element method, optimized the analysis results, manufactured the sensor experimental prototype, and constructed the coagulation testing device. We also tested the velocity spectral characteristics and displacement spectral characteristics of the sensor prototype, established the standard curve of POCT in the rapid detection of coagulation through matching the coagulation testing device with coagulation reagent, and compared its methodology with the imported POCT coagulometer system. Our results suggested that, the vibration velocity of the sensor designed in this study was 1.5μm/s, and the amplitude was 1.75×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>μm. The correlation with the imported POCT coagulometer system in terms of test results was as high as 0.996, and the repeatability was 0.002. This study can provide theory and experimental foundation for the electromagnetic vibration induction technology in coagulation detection.

articleTitle: Retrieving Wave Height Based on Shadow Statistics Method from X-band Marine Radar Images
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: When the effective wave height is retrieved by the shadow statistics, the echo intensity of the sea clutter in azimuth is changed as the change of the angle between the grazing incident direction of electromagnetic wave and the upwind direction. Thus, a large error exists in the estimated surface slope of RMS (root mean square) and effective wave height. In addition, the ideal analysis area is not always easy to be selected in the upwind direction because of the influence of land in the nearshore area. To solve these problems, the relationship between the echo intensity and the wind angle is investigated in this paper. The echo intensity of radar images is adjusted in azimuth based on the relationship. Then, the effective wave height is retrieved by utilizing the adjusted radar images based on the shadow statistics method. The data acquired from Pingtan island, which is the nearshore area of Fujian Province, were used to verify the effetiveness of the improved method. The experimental results show that the absolute error of the effective wave height obtained by using the adjusted radar image is smaller compared to the original method, and the accuracy of the effective wave height obtained is improved.

articleTitle: Reactive Power Control of Compound Reactive Power Compensation Device
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: A low-cost composite reactive power compensation model is proposed. The model consists of a Thyristor Switched Capacitor (TSC), a Thyristor Controlled Reactor (TCR) and a Static Var Generator (SVG). Firstly the paper completes the preliminary compensation by the large-capacity TSC+TCR module, and then the small-capacity SVG is responsible for subsequent fine compensation and suppression of voltage flicker. This two modules work together to improve the best in performance; the TSC+TCR adopts a method based on In the selective configuration strategy of the historical state, The output will change in a fixed form, the SVG adopts the direct current control, SVG is equivalent to a controlled current source, Feedback Control of SVG Output Current Instantaneous Value Using Tracking PWM Technology; the Simulink simulation model is established to verify the effectiveness of the composite reactive power compensation device. The simulation results show that the control strategy has the advantages of fast response and good compensation effect.

articleTitle: Reliability Assessment on Landmark Fixing Operation Based on Cloud Model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper has put forward analysis method based on cloud model for the reliability analysis of landmark positioning operation. The cloud model can realize the bilateral switching between qualitative concept and quantitative value. The three digital features are obtained through reverse cloud algorithm, which reflects the personnel operation level and the dispersion degree and stability of the operation. The personnel operation can be imitated through forward cloud algorithm so as to obtain the simulated cloud chart of actual operation point. The standard cloud is established by a series of standards, we use the standard cloud which is most similar to the actual operation as the evaluation result of the operation. The assessment of landmark positioning operation of the navigation operation personnel of a flight can prove this method is of reference value and strong practicality for the analysis on landmark fixing of navigation operation personnel.

articleTitle: Evaluation Method for the Performance of Light Screen Array Using Semi-Physical Simulation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The paper presents a novel method to evaluate the performance of light screen array (LSA) objectively and scientifically. First, we put forward the scheme of semi-physical verification platform based on arbitrary waveform generator (AWG), and this instrument is used as a substitute for light screen detector in the LSA. Next, according to some main characteristics of dynamic signal, the waveform files of two simulation signals with a certain time interval are compiled and created through configuring some options through a signal waveform edition software. Furthermore, these waveform files are downloaded into the AWG to generate two channel simulation signals. Then, the time interval of these two signals can be measured in the signal acquisition & processing module of LSA. Finally, we can compare the difference between true values and measured values. Through experiment and analysis, the proposed method can meet the requirement of performance evaluation on the LSA, and it is superior to the other previous methods.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Wire-wound Friction of Compact Inertially Stabilized Platforms
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Ideally, the effect of wire-wound friction on the motion of inertially stabilized platforms can be ignored. However, for compact inertially stabilized platforms, due to the strict limits of structure space, transmission of signals through wires between shafts is unavoidable. For a more functional maturation platform, more signals are needed to be transmitted through wires. Thus the effect of the wire-wound friction on the stabilized platform is greater. In order to analyze the influence of the wire-wound friction, the paper takes the simplified dynamic model of a compact inertially stabilized platform as its basis, and uses disturbance observer method to estimate the disturbance moment. A quantitative wire-wound friction model is established according to classical mechanics theory and a quantitative analysis of the influence of wire-wound friction on inertially stabilized platforms is established by simulation. The results demonstrate that that the wire-wound friction on the compact inertially stabilized platforms affects its control performance.

articleTitle: Wavelet De-noising Algorithm and Application Based on Improved Threshold Function
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The Wavelet Analysis is one of the important analysis ways for the signal processing after Fourier analysis and it has wide applying prospects in the fields of modern science research and technology. This paper gives an improved wavelet threshold de-noising algorithm based on the analysis of the traditional hard and the soft function. This optimal method has better flexibility, higher SNR, smaller MSE and smaller REPV than the hard and the soft algorithms through relevant simulation activities which prove the improved function works well.

articleTitle: The Optimization Design of Micro-Strip UHF Sensor and the Applied Research of GIS PD Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: UHF technology is an important method in Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) Partial Discharge (PD) detection, which is applied on large scale both at home and abroad. UHF sensor is the key part of UHF PD detection system, whose quality directly decides the performance of the detection system. This paper will employ micro-strip theory to make a targeted design of UHF sensors according to the traits of GIS PD. The author will start from the design of rectangular patch micro-strip sensor, and make a modeling analysis of its operating characteristics, then introduce fractal theory on that basis to design a fractal microstrip sensor suitable for GIS PD detection and conduct simulated analysis on the proposed model. The last step is to develop the material object of the sensor, then put it to detection test on the simulation test platform to verify its detectability and performance. The experimental results show that the fractal micro-strip sensor has wide detection signal band and high sensitivity. It can detect the PD signal precisely, providing a new design idea for GIS PD detection sensors.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influence Factors of Underwater Motor Temperature Field Based on Magneto-thermal-flux Coupling
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The computation domain of the temperature field of submersible motor is numerically solved using the finite volume method (FVM). Firstly, the change law of the loss is obtained by loss calculation. The loss heat source analysis result is applied as the boundary condition using the method of magneto-thermal-flux coupling. Then, based on the inlet temperature variation which is obtained according to the temperature drop between inlet and outlet, the influence of inlet temperature and inlet velocity variation on the motor temperature is analyzed. The absolute error between simulation results and test results is 5%. The importance of temperature analysis of the motor considering the change of inlet temperature is explained by experiments. The temperature distribution of the motor is obtained under the condition of local variation of internal flow field based on the above results of analysis and experiments, which show that the motor temperature is obviously reduced by increasing the number of flow paths. The results obtained in this paper can provide support for the optimization of the circulatory system.

articleTitle: Rotor Design of Ultra-high Speed PM Motor with Self-starting Ability
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Due to the fact that traditional ultra-high speed permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) has no self-starting ability, this paper proposes a type of rotor by embedding a hysteresis ring/cylinder in it, and then the PMSM can use the hysteresis torque to start. Three different rotor structures are considered, and their transient starting performances are calculated by 2D finite element (FE) method, respectively. The results show the PMSM equipped with the designed rotors can achieve self-starting. PM torque and hysteresis torque are separated from the total electromagnetic torque, and the influence mechanism of PM on the hysteresis torque is analyzed and summarized.

articleTitle: Research on Accurate Screening Technology for Circulating Tumor Cells
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In order to achieve efficient enrichment of circulating tumor cells (CTCs), an accurate screening device for circulating tumor cells was designed to provide a more effective new technology and device for early clinical screening, detection and treatment of tumor cells and provide research foundation for precision medical. The system was designed which used microfluidic technology, chromatography, and centrifugation methods and combined the physical and biological characteristics of tumor cells. Through the integration technology of microfluidic carrier discs, microporous membranes of polymer materials, enrichment reagents and embedded test instruments to achieve the stain and enrichment of CTCs. The separation plate and device were designed for easy operation and high enrichment rate which can meet the demand completely.

articleTitle: Research on Automatic Locating Method for Large Hydraulically-Driven Loading Arm Based on Visual Servo
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: An automatic docking method for connecting the loading-arm robot with the oil pipeline was proposed. The kinematic modeling of the loading arm, the design of loading arm control system and the visual servo system were introduced. Firstly, the transformation matrixes from the coordinate system established on the terminal joint to the based coordinate system of the loading arm were derived, rotary angles of the loading arm's joints can be detected from the encoders, then the pose of the terminal joint can be obtained. Secondly, the control program of the loading arm was developed on a Linux operating system with a Xenomai real-time kernel. Thirdly, based on the target position detected by the visual servo system, the loading arm can be automatically controlled to dock with the oil pipeline. Finally, the docking method of the loading-arm robot was verified by experiments, the test results also showed that the position errors of the loading arm were below 40mm, with the special mechanical guidance, the position errors were within the allowable range.

articleTitle: A Method for Locating Reading Area of Digital Instrument Based on Color Characteristics
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The goal of this work is to solve the positioning problems of the digital meter reading area under complicated background. This paper starts with the basic principles and methods of digital image processing, uses a special grayscale empirical algorithm to locate the LCD screen by analyzing the color characteristics of the LCD screen. Experiments on the actual pictures show that the proposed algorithm has good adaptability to most kinds of digital instruments with complicated dial information and effectively solves the positioning problems of the LCD screen, and positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Application of a Novel Fast Transfer Alignment Algorithm on SINS for Vehicular Launching System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: To improve the transfer alignment precision and reduce the alignment time of Strapdown Inertial Navigation System (SINS) for fast-response and maneuvering launching of vehicular launching system are of great importance. In this paper, a novel fast and high-precision transfer alignment algorithm is designed. The “speed + attitude” matching model is used for transfer alignment filter measurement updates, and meanwhile its lever-arm error is compensated and eliminated through the direct calculation. In addition, an embedded hardware platform of transfer alignment information solution system is constructed based on the FPGA+DSP processor. Finally, in order to verify the performances of the transfer alignment algorithm, a vehicular launching system is used as the carrier, and the launching arm is erected as the transfer alignment maneuvering condition. The results shown that the azimuth misalignment error estimated by transfer alignment system is less than 3', and the errors of pitch and roll misalignment angles are less than 2' within 10s launching arm maneuvering condition, which proves the effectiveness and viability of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Redundancy Design of a New Electrically Powered Actuator for Aerospace Application
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Electro-Mechanical-Hydrostatic Actuator (EMHA) is a new type of electrically powered actuator that acts on thrust vector control system (TVC). The reliability of the redundancy system was researched, and the fault tree method was used to analyze the fault of the EMHA system, and task reliability was also calculated; then, the redundancy design of the EMHA system was carried out from the point of the overall redundancy, and the switch valve block that is the key role in the EMHA system was analyzed in detail. Finally, the redundancy design of the EMHA system was carried out from the point of the component redundancy. The ideas and suggestions of EMHA system redundancy scheme was given based on the above procedures.

articleTitle: Different Reformulation, ZD Tracking Control and Analysis of One-Link Rigid Robot System with Motor Dynamics
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: As machinery transmission devices, motors are commonly utilized in robot systems and may significantly affect the dynamic characteristics and stability of robot systems. In view of the fundamental role of the one-link rigid robot system, this paper investigates the tracking control of such a system with motor dynamics. Based on Zhang dynamics (ZD), a new kind of ZD controller is developed and investigated for achieving the tracking-control purpose. Besides, the characteristics and differences of the ZD method compared with other conventional methods are presented. Moreover, theoretical analysis and result are also presented to guarantee the global and exponential convergence performance of the ZD controller.

articleTitle: An Online Virtual Gyroscope Technique Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Inertial device is the core of the SINS and the gyroscope senses the angular velocity of the carrier. The failure of the gyroscope causes the navigation system to be unable to resolve the attitude of the carrier. In order to improve the fault-tolerance of SINS, this paper proposes an online virtual gyroscope algorithm based on convolutional neural network using IMU's own realtime data and analyzes the feasibility of online virtual algorithm. First, the equations for calculating the angular velocity of the carrier using the information contained in the accelerometer are analyzed to determine the input data and output data of the convolutional neural network. Then, the online training convolutional neural network model is established, and a four-layer neural network with two convolutional layers, one fully connected layer, and an output layer is proposed as the predicting model.
