Finally, the feasibility of the proposed virtual algorithm is verified by mathematical simulation.

articleTitle: Research on Imaging Model and Unwrapping Algorithm of Catadioptrio-mnidirectional Vision System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper discuss some key techniques of the single view point (SVP) catadioptric-omnidirectional Vision System: the system composition, the optical imaging principle, the unified-sphere imaging model and the image unwrapping methods. The unified imaging model based on spherical projection is analyzed and deduced. The comparison experimental results of the panoramic image unwrapping methods based on different projection models shows that the cylindrical expansion algorithm based on the unified-sphere imaging model can obtain the undistorted images quickly and easily, which is more suitable for real-time tasks.

articleTitle: System Design of Transcranial Electromagnetic Stimulator Combined with tDCS and rTMS
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Transcranial magnetic stimulation (TES) and transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) have been proved to be safe, effective and noninvasive means of functional regulation of the brain.which is widely used in the study of brain function and the rehabilitation therapy of nervous system diseases. There are many electrical stimulator and magnetic stimulation equipments in the market, but their functions are relatively simple. In order to meet the needs of electromagnetic combined therapy and medical experiments, this paper presents an electromagnetic stimulator that can achieve two functions: transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) and repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS). The stimulator can realize the key input and display of the stimulus parameters. The signal generator can output the direct current stimulation signal and the magnetic stimulation signal of the specific frequency. The stimulator can select the corresponding electrode and magnetic stimulation coil through socket, which can satisfy the basic electromagnetic stimulation needs. The design has a certain innovation and feasibility.

articleTitle: Development of Operating Parameters Acquisition System on Marine Diesel Engine
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This article describes the exploration of operating parameters collection and analysis system for the marine diesel engine based on AC6111 high speed A / D acquisition card. Pressure sensor is used for the engine cylinder pressure signal creation. After amplifier and wavelet filter, the signal is sent to the marine diesel engine parameters acquisition and analysis procedures which compiled by Labview language to collect the cylinder pressure and save the pressure data in real-time. Meanwhile the cylinder pressure curve and heat release curve adapting to the change of crank angle are displayed. At the same time, the coordinate of the operating parameter can be showed on the curves.

articleTitle: Development of Phased Array Ultrasonic Detection System Using a Post-Processing Technique
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: - Phased array ultrasonic is an advanced method of ultrasonic testing that has application in medical imaging and industrial nondestructive testing. Compared with single-element probes, a phased array probe can focus and swept the beam electronically without moving the probe. An ultrasonic testing system has been established using phased array probes and postprocessing technique. Processing of ultrasonic array data is traditionally based on having parallel transmission circuits that enable staggered firing of transmitter elements to produce the desired wavefront. This paper describes an approach in which the full matrix of time domain signals from every transmitter-receiver pair is captured and post-processed. An advanced processing algorithm is implemented which allows the array to be focused at every point in the target region. In addition, the experimental detecting process and system have been designed and the testing results of composite material part are presented which show the efficiency and feasibility of this ultrasonic detection system.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Neural Network Fast Terminal Sliding Mode Controller for Hovering Motion of Underwater Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: An adaptive neural network fast terminal sliding mode control method which was applied to the hovering motion control of underwater vehicles was proposed in this paper. Based on the conventional fast terminal sliding mode control algorithm, the RBF neural network was introduced, of which the weight adaptation law was obtained by back-stepping method. Compared with the conventional sliding mode controllers, this controller was composed to solve the problem of the dependence on the parameters of the system. At the same time, the stability of the closed-loop system was proved using Lyapunov function. In the end, a simulation is presented, where three control methods were applied to control the hovering motion of underwater vehicle and the results showed that the proposed control method was more superior in terms of the accuracy, rapidity, and robustness.

articleTitle: Energy Saving Technology Based on Variable Frequency Speed Regulation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: With the emergence of the energy crisis, more and more attention has been focused on energy saving. The energy saving technology of motor has also been widely concerned, because it is the main energy consumer. As the most potential energy saving technology, the variable frequency speed regulation has a good prospect of energy saving. It is of great significance to study the variable frequency speed control technology. This paper analyses the loss of asynchronous motor, and mainly discussed the key technology and existing problems of the variable frequency speed regulation.

articleTitle: High-Frequency Modeling of Common-Mode Chokes Based on the Identification of Frequency-Varying Parameters
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: To overcome the disadvantage of impedance measurement which is influenced by parasitic parameters and non-ideal characters of conductor lines as well as cannot perform the frequency-varying parameters. This paper presents a high-frequency modeling method of common-mode chokes based on frequency-varying parameters. A high-frequency lumped parameter model was built, which included winding inductances, leakage inductances, parasitic capacitances between and in the windings, equivalent resistances of magnetic cores and copper losses. Using traditional least-square method, the forgetting factor and rectangular window was introduced to estimate the frequency-varying parameters. The mean square convergence of this method is proved. The modeling method proposed in this paper is proven accurately by comparing the experimental result with simulation result between 150 kHz-30 MHz. The restraining effects are best at the resonance frequency of the common-mode choke. In addition, an experiment is conducted to verify the conclusion by restraining the electromagnetic interference produced by a switching circuit.

articleTitle: A Research Method of Uncertain Propagation Problems Based on Maximum Entropy Principle
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The problem of uncertainty propagation is widely found in practical engineering problems. Most of the existing research methods have problems in accuracy and efficiency in practical engineering problems. Thus, a new method to study the problem of uncertainty propagation is proposed. Firstly, an approximate numerical method combined with the Bootstrap method is used to calculate the statistical moments of each order of the response variable, and then the method based on the maximum entropy principle is used to solve the probability density function. In this paper, a numerical example and an example of the calculation of the probability density function of natural frequency of a barrel are given and compared with the Monte Carlo simulation method to show the advantages of this method in the problem of uncertainty propagation, and the effectiveness of this method is verified.

articleTitle: Development of a Percussive Ultrasonic Drill Driver
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Compared with the conventional drill driven by magnetic motors, percussive ultrasonic drill (PUD) shows advantages of small size, low power, low axial load, and lubrication free, making it available for the extraterrestrial rock sampling, especially for the minor planet with a weak gravitational field. The influence of the environment, load and aging of the components cause the resonance frequency of the PUD to drift, which causes the drilling efficiency of the PUD decreases drastically. During the PUD drilling rocks, the load imposed on the transducer is fickle. Though, the conventional frequency tracking control which tracking frequency by locking fixed phase does not perform well for the PUD. This paper presents a novel driving approach for the PUD, including the working principle of the PUD and a detailed design approach for the PUD driver. A driving circuit and a control algorithm were developed successfully. The experimental results show that the driver can drive the PUD effectively and make the drill work stably near the resonant frequency under different conditions.

articleTitle: Study on Design of Experiments based Kriging Model for Tool Life Prediction
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: For the tool life prediction, it is hard to obtain the exact model to do prediction. The establishment of surrogate model for the prediction or optimization of complex issues is a useful way. However, the accuracy of surrogate model mostly depends on the arrangement of samples (experiment data). Therefore, in this paper, three types of design of experiments (DOE) are analyzed and compared based the Kriging model. The six-hump camel back function is used to test the accuracies and amounts of computation of three DOEs. The results show that Latin hypercube sampling design with the Kriging model method is the best combination for the accuracy of surrogate model and the amounts of computation of DOE. Finally, this combination is applied to develop the surrogate model of tool life prediction and the accuracy is accepted in practical engineering.

articleTitle: The Primary Exploration of Application about Functional Reconstruction and Structure Reconstruction in Microgrid
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper confronts the issue that lacking of an efficient way to achieve micro-grid (MG) optimal dispatching and proposes a framework based on the idea of structural reconfiguration and functional reconfiguration to achieve MG optimal dispatching. The multi-functional grid connected inverter (MFGCI) with the function of functional reconfiguration and its control strategy are presented by giving consideration to both MG power quality and the grid connected inverter effectiveness. Aiming at curbing the impact of low efficiency of power output to power grid induced by the cloud shading and non-uniform radiation, a novel dispatching approach is proposed based on the idea of PV array reconfiguration. The proposed MG model is established based on the IEEE 34 bus test feeder system. Simulation results show that effectiveness and feasibility of proposed framework.

articleTitle: High Efficiency Off-line Programming for Robotic Blisk Grinding with Constant Contact Force
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: A blisk blade has a space free-form surface, which is extremely complicated and requires high precision. Manual grinding and polishing is still the dominant finish machining method for bilsks. However, the manual grinding has low efficiency, high cost and is harmful to the workers. Traditional path planning and off-line programming method makes the path points nonuniform in order to fit surface better. To solve the existing problems, this paper presents a novel path planning method for robotic grinding of complex blisk surfaces with a smart force-controlled end effector. After reasonable and sparse optimizing to the grinding path, the surface of the blisk blade is subjected to constant force grinding. On this basis, grinding experiments are carried out to validate the performance of the proposed method. The experimental results show that the surface roughness of the blisk blade is within Ra0.4. The grinding efficiency is increased nearly six times compared to traditional path planning method, and the resolution of the contact force control is within 1 N.

articleTitle: Model Reference Adaptive Control for a Human Support Robot with Omniwheel Touchdown Characteristic
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper investigates the trajectory tracking control for a Human Support Robot (HSR) considering omniwheel touchdown characteristic. A novel model reference adaptive law is designed to account for the omniwheel touchdown characteristic, which will be used to the design of trajectory tracking controller. Based on Lyapunov stability theory and LaSalle's invariance principle, it is proved that the designed model reference adaptive controller can make the tracking error system asymptotically stable. Simulation results demonstrate the necessary consideration of the omniwheel touchdown characteristic and the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: A Curvature-Continuous Transition Method with Axis High-Order Kinematic Limitations along Linear Segments
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Linear toolpath is the most typical codes in practical Computer Numerical Control (CNC) systems and the kinematic parameters in terms of axis acceleration and jerk are difficult to limited in high-speed and high-precision machining. Various path-smoothing approaches are proposed to cope with that drawback, while the axis jerk is still not limited in most researches. In order to improve the machining quality further, corner feedrate limitations with axis jerk are deduced in theory. Similarly to the curvature extreme, the curvature derivative extreme should also become the critical points and it would determine the distribution of axis jerk. With the typical cubic Bspline transition method, the transition model is optimized to obtain smaller curvature derivative extreme, which leads to larger corner feedrate as well as higher machining efficiency. Thereby, a new motion planning algorithm is presented with jerk limited acceleration profile to adapt the changes of critical points. Finally, simulation and experiment comparisons of three already existing approaches are presented to show obvious improvements in both cycle time and contouring performance.

articleTitle: Research on Marine Autopilot and its Performance Test
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Shipborne steering system is the main heading control device for marine vehicle. Advanced autopilots are researched and equipped. However, there were still a considerable number of aged ships using hydraulic steering system. It is quite difficult to install novel electromagnetic steering aiming to replace the existed hydraulic ones for their extremely complex hydraulic tube. In this paper, we present an effective hydraulic steering system upgrade solution. As additional components, rudder and heading angle sensors are installed to measure steering and ship turning parameters. Then, a double close-loop control mode is established to generate control instructions. The connect section of wheel and hydraulic steering gear mounts with a automatic wheel drive, which conduct the steering instructions. Simulation shows that the proposed upgraded marine autopilot has an excellent steering and heading maintain performance.

articleTitle: Study on Steering Mobility of Multi-axle Vehicles with Independent Braking System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Multi-axle vehicles are often used in off-road or heavy-load conditions, with large size and more than one steering axle. Steering radius of multi-axle vehicle is large and steering mobility is worse than normal vehicles because of long wheelbase. For multi-vehicles with independent braking system, when inner wheels of rear two axles are braked and driving torque of other wheels is increased, steering radius decreases and mobility is improved. A new method of improve steering mobility through braking inner wheels is proposed. Through establishment and analysis of an 11-DOF vehicle model, the change regulation of steering radius under different steering angle and driving torque is obtained. As driving torque grows, steering radius decreases, the rate of decrease gradually slows down. As steer angle of front wheel grows, steering radius decreases. The results show that the proposed method can effectively decrease steering radius and increase steering mobility.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Lock System of Hydraulic Turbine Lifting Device
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: According to the characteristics of floating tidal turbines subjected to complex loads from marine, a symmetrical rack locking system was designed. When the turbine is lowered to the power generation position, the turbine can be fixed on the carrier without any gaps. Using the Bets theory, the maximum instantaneous axial force of the turbine subjected to the action of the carrier longitudinal and pitching is obtained, and then it is concluded that the axial force acting on the turbine is time-varying and has the same period as the shaking of the carrier. Establish the dynamic equation of turbine column and solve the dynamic characteristics of the locking force of the locking system under the action of the carrier shaking. Based on the sub-modeling analysis method of ANSYS, the finite element analysis of the locking system was performed to verify the stress variation of the locking rack. The simulation results show that the designed locking system meets the conditions of use, which verifies the feasibility of this design and simulation method.

articleTitle: Automatic Detection of Moving Baw Baw Frogs in Camera Trap Videos
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of a motion detection algorithm for processing of video sequences captured by a purpose-built camera trap, removing of unwanted frames, and reducing of the size of the video sequences. The camera trap is used to create a dataset containing H.264 video sequences of the critically endangered Baw Baw Frog Philoria frosti. A motion detection method based on the optical flow Farneback algorithm is then developed to reduce the size of the video sequences by detecting the frames that contain moving frogs, keeping and storing the detected frames, and discarding the frames that do not contain moving frogs. Twenty video sequences containing a total of 13770 frames are used in this study. The frames with moving frogs are detected with sensitivity of 0.993, specificity of 0.992, and accuracy of 0.992. The original video sequences are then replaced by the newly created video sequences that are much smaller in size with an average reduction of 80.4% for the test video sequences used in this study.

articleTitle: Study on a Numerical Simulation of a Manipulator Task Verification Facility System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The manipulator task verification facility (MTVF) system is a ground testing system for verifying space robot capturing operations. In this paper, a numerical simulation of the MTVF system is established to ensure the security of the devices in physical contact and to verify the control algorithm in the MTVF system. The MTVF simulation consists of four main modeling parts: the dynamics model of a space robot, the dynamics model of a target object, the dynamics models of the emulation robots and contact dynamics models. In order to be close to the real contact process, the nonlinear damping contact model and the 3-dimensional bristle friction force model are employed in the contact dynamics models. The MTVF simulation considering the approaching phase is simulated to show the performance of the MTVF system. Two grasping processes with different grasping velocities are conducted in the MTVF simulation to analyze and to ensure the safety of the MTVF system during the contact process. Simulation results demonstrate the necessity of the MTVF simulation.

articleTitle: Application of QGA-BP Network in Objective Evaluation of Speech Jamming Effect
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In order to overcome the shortcomings of traditional BP (Back Propagation) in the process of evaluation for continuous speech jamming effect, a method based on QGA (Quantum Genetic Algorithm) is proposed to optimize the BP network for objective evaluation of speech jamming effect. The MFCC feature of continuous speech data under different distortion conditions are extracted by the Mel cepstrum, which are set to the model inputs in the QGA-BP method. Then the QGA is used to optimize the weight and threshold of BP neural network from multiple spots. A QGA-BP model is constructed to accomplish the mapping from the input to the Mean Opinion Score (MOS). Representative speech data is used to verify this method, and the results show that the convergence speed of QGA-BP model is improved compared with the traditional BP network. Meanwhile, the convergence error can be effectively controlled within 4%, and the model correlation coefficient and the standard deviation are closer to the ideal parameters.

articleTitle: Atlas_GcodeSender: a Graphical User Interface for Control of a Robotics Additive Manufacturing Platform
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This work deals with the designing and developing a Graphical User Interface (GUI), called Atlas_GcodeSender, for control of a 3D printer based on a 5R parallel robot. First, a conceptual design stage is performed through an application activities modeling (AAM) by using the nomenclature of IDEF0. The programming each functional module of the GUI in JAVA language is also detailed. Atlas_ GcodeSender allows three control modes: manual, semiautomatic/MDI (Manual Data Input) and automatic, and it has been implemented on a 3D printing process using a 5R parallel robot with open technology controller.

articleTitle: Research on Online Testing System of Flow Characteristics for Vehicle Electronic Fuel Injector
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Complied with relevant standards, a novel on-line testing system for flow characteristics of electronic fuel injector was proposed in this paper. The designed structure of the system was described in details, as well as the composition and principle of the control unit. The testing process on the dynamic flow and the static flow of the port fuel injectors driven by voltage was implemented. According to the experimental results, the error of the on-line system is less than 4%, which can meet the requirements on flow characteristics test of fuel injectors. At the same time, the on-line system has practical application values.

articleTitle: Research on Target Tracking Algorithm Based on Variance Sampling for Fast Sparse Representation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The Sparse Representation tracking algorithm under particle filter framework has many problems, such as large number of particles and complexity of l1 norm minimization calculation. To refine the issues mentioned above, a fast sparse representation target tracking algorithm based on variance sampling is proposed. The algorithm first uses the variance estimation to optimize the distribution of sampling particles in the motion estimation stage; Then, the discriminant objective function is solved by using l2 norm instead of l1 norm, furthermore, the improvement of the measurement form of the reconstruction error is made to enhance the sparsity of the l2 norm; Finally, online dictionary learning (ODL) algorithm to update the template dictionary online. The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can greatly improve the tracking efficiency under the premise of ensuring stable tracking and accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on in-Situ Calibration Technology of Six-dimension Force Sensor for the LIDM Docking Performance Test-bed
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Low impact docking mechanism (LIDM) docking performance test-bed (‘performance test-bed’ for short), which mainly provides the test conditions for ground test (such as docking, maintenance and separation), is used for ground docking performance test of LIDM applied for Lunar Exploration Program. The accuracy of the six-dimension force sensor has a great impact on the test performance of the performance test-bed. In this paper, for in-Situ calibration of the six-dimension force sensor, the principle of force calibration is analyzed firstly; secondly, taking the calibration of Y force as an example, a calibration loading device is designed, and the main supporting parts of the device are analyzed by Pro/Mechanica software; finally, the force calibration device is verified through experimental research, and the performance of the six-dimension force sensor is also investigated.

articleTitle: Study on Adhesion Effect of Martian Dust to Spacecraft Based on DEM-CFD Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Mars dust accumulated on the solar array can affect the long-term performance of the solar array. Due to the thin gas flow on Mars, it is difficult to carry out experimental research and this paper study the wind removal process of Martian dust through theory and simulation. Firstly, this paper analyzed the mechanical properties of Martian dust and simulated Martian dust and established the discrete element model of Martian dust. Then the effect of Martian dust on spacecraft under different turbulence models in DEM-CFD model was analyzed. Finally, the simulation was performed and the influence of various parameters on the critical start-up speed of Mars dust was analyzed.

articleTitle: Image Stitching Algorithm Based on Embedded System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Image stitching can be achieved through the algorithm to the input of the conventional camera at different angles of ordinary images. This paper consider the actual needs, Study image stitching algorithm in embedded Linux system and realize fast and accurate stitching, Finally complete image stitching in the embedded system. Using the FPGA-based embedded hardware and software system development process, with the DEO-Nano-SoC to build embedded Linux system platform. The algorithms used in each stage of image stitching are studied, and the advantages and disadvantages between each algorithm are analyzed and compared.

articleTitle: Research on Motion Control of Mechanical Arm Based on Laser Guidance
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper describes research on a type of mechanical arm whose terminal position is given by laser. By means of moving the PTZ (Pan/Tilt/Zoom) with a laser device on it, mechanical arm can be controlled to work on a lot of tasks, such as demolition, vision localization of humanoid robot. Actually it is one key technology of most types of robot. For laser-guided manipulators, there have been similar methods previously. However, these are often not very convenient and the errors are large in practical uses. This article introduced the research process of laser-guided robotic arm, combined with the actual research platform, focused on the coordinate acquisition and transformation process. Comparing the novelties with previous methods shows that this method can be effectively applied to a similar environment. In addition, the kinematic derivation process and control method design are also introduced. All results of research were applied to demolish robot and were proved to be effective.

articleTitle: Structural Optimization Design of a High-precision Compact Position Sensitive Detector
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The position sensitive detector (PSD) based on the transverse photoelectric effect is a non-segmented photoelectric device, which can measure the center of the gravity of the incident light energy. This paper introduces the basic principles of semiconductor optoelectronic PSD and the performance characteristics of two-dimensional PSD devices. At the same time, a new type of PSD structure is optimized designed. The position and angle of the beam can be measured at the same time. The experimental results show that the PSD can obtain the resolution of micro-meter and sub micro-rad. The precision of the angle of the PSD A is about one order of magnitude higher than that of the PSD chip.

articleTitle: Brittle Fracture Effect on Dislocation Density of Single Crystal Germanium During Turning
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Single crystal germanium is widely used in many industries because of its unique properties. At present, most scholars focus on the study of germanium plastic cutting and other problems. The surface damage of brittle cutting is seldom mentioned, but single crystal germanium plastic cutting must undergo brittle fracture process. Brittle fracture leads to dislocation movement resulting in residual stress in the surface layer of single crystal germanium by dislocation, which affects the subsequent processing process. The grain size, interplanar spacing, dislocation density, surface roughness and surface morphology of single crystal germanium (111) with surface depth less than 60μm were studied, respectively, by means of X-ray diffractometer and other instruments such as proscan 2100 surface profilometer. By changing the grain integrity, there is no obvious regular change in surface roughness. The dislocation density increases first and then decreases, with the increase of grain size. The existence of dislocation will affect the properties of some finished products of single crystal germanium, and may even cause the failure of ultra-precision cutting of single crystal germanium. Therefore, it is necessary to study the formation law of single crystal germanium.

articleTitle: Noise Control and Experimental Study of Engine Oil Pump
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: At the design beginning of a certain type of passenger car, the noise spectrum of the air intake system is analyzed. Firstly, the structure model and acoustic model are established by GEM3D, and then GT-Power was used to analyze the noise of the system and simulate the full load condition of the engine. The sound pressure levels of the third, sixth, ninth, and twelfth order nozzle noise at 1000-6000r/min were respectively calculated and optimized. Comparing the sound pressure levels, the results show that the each order and the total sound pressure levels of the intake system do not exceed the target curve to meet the noise reduction requirements.

articleTitle: Consecutive Feature Network for Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Feature Pyramid Network (FPN) is one of the best object detection algorithms in the current object detection field, which uses convolutional neural network (CNN) to detect different scaled objects in an image. However, FPN's feature fusion method ignores the influence of the consecutive feature, which hinders the information flow. In this paper, we proposed an end-to-end image detection model called CFN (Consecutive Feature Network) to overcome this problem and speed up the detection process. Under the premise of equal accuracy, the novel feature fusion method we propose can detect faster than other methods. In the feature fusion module, features from consecutive layers with different scales are merged instead of compartmental layers, which will be fed to the classification and regression subnet to predict the final detection results. On the PASCAL VOC 2007 test, without any data augmentation training skills, our proposed network can achieve 77.1 mAP (mean average precision) at the speed of 3.9 FPS (frame per second) on a single Nvidia 1080Ti GPU. Code will be made publicly available.

articleTitle: Research on Oscillating Buoy Wave Energy Generation Based on VSG Control Strategy
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Although the wave power generation system has made gratifying progress, the poor stability of the output of the power generation device is one of the main factors restricting its easy realization of large-scale commercial operation. A single wave power generation system is usually an independent power generation system or directly connected to the offshore power distribution system, the current operation of the wave power is mostly such devices. In this paper, we propose a wave power generator with virtual synchronous generator (VSG) control strategy on the inverter side. The simulation of the oscillating float type wave energy generating device is carried out and the results indicate the control strategy can achieve the effect of smoothing the power generation frequency to suppressing power fluctuation. Finally, combined with the virtual synchronous machine adaptive mode simulation, to prove its use value in the complex conditions of the wave power generation system.

articleTitle: Smart Material Constructed Flexible and Stretchable Electronics for Knee Joint Health Monitoring and Improved Drug Delivery
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper presents a flexible and stretchable electronic device with multi-functionality. This device contains the functional node array coated smart materials and can be packaged with biocompatible polydimethylsiloxane (PDMS) films as a smart patch. Two kinds of smart materials are utilized: piezoelectric lead zirconate titanate (PZT) film for sensing acoustic emission (AE) wave and thermally activated Poly(N-isopropylacrylamide) PNIPAM film for delivering drug. The functional node array is implemented on a thin flexible titanium sheet with serpentine network electrically connected. This design has two advantages: (1) the serpentine network allows the node array to stretch in an arbitrary planar direction; (2) while the patch is stretched, the normal force exerted by the node can enhance the AE detection head coupling to the sensing object as well as increase the contact force/area of PNIPAM film. The fabrication and experimental results of the designed serpentine network AE sensing module along with the temperature controlled drug release element are reported. The demonstration of the smart patch assembled with a knee band strap for monitoring the knee joint motion is also described.

articleTitle: Research on UUV Fixed-point Hovering Control Based on Model Predictive Control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV) fixed-point hovering control provides the important technical foundation for various military and civilian applications of UUV. According to the nonlinearity of UUV model, an UUV fixed-point hovering controller was designed based on nonlinear model predictive control algorithm. Firstly, the kinetic and dynamical model of UUV of Four Degree of Freedom (4-DOF) was established, and the controller's prediction model was given based on the state space model. Secondly, according to the given performance index, the Taylor series expansion and Lie derivative are used to solve the optimal control law under the continuous time state, the UUV fixed-point hovering control is achieved. Finally, a simulation experiment was carried out, the result proves effectiveness of the design of the fixed-point hovering controller.

articleTitle: Adaptive UPF Based Interacting Multiple Model Algorithm for Integrated Navigation
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: To resolve issues such as the degraded particle performance and difficulty in selecting the importance density function of particle filtering, this paper introduces an adaptive Unscented particle filter (UPF) based interacting multiple model algorithm. The method benefits from both the interacting multiple model filter and Unscented particle filter. It first uses the Unscented kalman filter to get the latest measurement information at k time for each model. And then, it takes interaction of the corresponding particle as input of each model, after matching the model and updating the probability of model and using residual re-sampling. Finally, it outputs interaction of the corresponding particle for each model. The proposed algorithm has been used in the GPS/DR integrated navigation system. Simulation results and their analysis demonstrate that the position and velocity error calculation of the proposed algorithm is much better than the Unscented particle filter, and the algorithm certainly improves the calculation accuracy of the GPS/DR integrated navigation system.

articleTitle: Research on the Breakage Detection Technology of Fuel Assembly Based on Sip and Data Analysis Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Fuel assembly is the core of nuclear reactor. Although fuel assembly has been designed, manufactured and operated to a very high level, reactor safe operating limits also allow fuel assembly to have a certain breakage rate, however, if fuel assembly is broken, fission products will escape from the break, which may affect reactor operation and environmental safety. Based on the theory of fission product release after the breakdown of fuel assemblies, this paper has described the work about breakage detection based on sip and data analysis techniques. The study results indicate that the method of detecting fission gas samples by sipping and combining data analysis techniques can feasibly detect and evaluate fuel assembly breakage.

articleTitle: The Time Course of Symmetry Effect on Shape Perception: an Event-related Potential Study
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Although symmetry is known to be an important determinant of visual processing and an appreciation of visual symmetry has been studied in several electroencephalography (EEG) experiments, it remains not well clear the mechanism of visual symmetry processing. To investigate this, we measured the processing of symmetrical stimulus (diagonal) and asymmetrical stimulus (control) with two levels of intensity by measured visual evoked potential (VEP). Our results showed significant difference in P8, P4 and O2, the right hemisphere for symmetry processing. In addition, the activity of visual related cortex for diagonal was weaker than that for control during the period of (160-190 ms), whereas the relationship was inverse during the period of (220-280 ms) in all intensity. This work provides a new account of neural mechanisms involved in visual symmetry perception.

articleTitle: Design and Pouring Process of Packaging Mold for Electromagnetic Paraffin Preventer
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In the process of crude oil extraction and transportation, electromagnetic paraffin preventer is exposed to the outdoor working environment for a long time and will be affected by various unfavorable factors, which will reduce the service life. The package mold was designed for the working condition of the electromagnetic paraffin preventer. The mold processing technology was analyzed. Through actual production and application, this package mold has a simple design and is easy to be manufactured. In the course of using, the mold is easy to be removed, and the packaged product formed by pouring has a picturesque appearance. And at the same time, the waste of resin and the environmental pollution is prevented. Pouring process designed is reasonable, which is conducive to mass production of products. In summary, this package mold meets engineering requirements.

articleTitle: Analysis of polarization modulation laser ranging principle
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Based on pulsed time-of-flight method, polarization-modulated laser ranging technology use electro-optic modulation technology to realize time resolution, and optical distances are used to extract target distance information, which can effectively reduce the distance measurement errors introduced by photoelectric conversion and electrical signal processing systems. The requirement for detector bandwidth is reduced, high-speed timing circuits do not need to be designed, and long-distance, high-precision ranging is achieved. In this dissertation, the principle of polarization-modulated laser ranging is studied. The basic structure of ranging system is analyzed through the combination of theoretical analysis, simulation and experimental verification. Based on this, the time-resolving principle of the electro-optic modulator based on the linear electro-optic effect of the crystal is analyzed using the refractive index ellipsoid theory. The distance ranging selection method is proposed for the problem of limited range of the system. Finally, the correspondence between the intensity of the polarized light and the modulation time is verified by experiments, which provides a theoretical basis for the application of polarization modulation laser ranging technology.

articleTitle: Forward Kinematics Analysis of 6-PORO Secondary Mirror Alignment Mechanisms
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper presents a new 6 degree of freedom(6-DOF)secondary mirror alignment mechanism for space optical payload. The moving platform is connected to the base by six kinematic branch chains, each branch chain is composed of Prismatic joint P, two Offset RR-hinges and Revolute joint R. Compared to the parallel platforms with universal joint configuration, the forward kinematics problem of the parallel platform with Offset RR-hinges is much more complicated due to the existence of dependent joint variables. In this paper, the numerical solution of the forward kinematics is presented and solved by the Newton-Raphson method. The simulation results are carried out to verify the accuracy and efficiency of the forward kinematics solution. The prototype has been developed and the proposed procedure is verified by the experimental test.

articleTitle: Edge Detection Method Used for Red Laser Stripe Located on Microscope Images
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The computer vision with the laser stripe scanning method is widely used in the macro field of shape reconstruction and measurement for the objects with a large-scale. On the basis of the macro laser stripe scanning method, we proposed a new method with a stereo light microscope and laser stripe scanning to be used in the micro filed of shape reconstruction and measurement for the objects with a micro-scale. And this article is especially concerned with the problem of edge detection of laser stripes located on microscope images. First, we analyzed the character of microscope image and proposed an edge detection algorithm for these laser stripes based on Canny rule. Then, an edge filter is used to smooth the edge burrs. At last, the Hermite interpolation method is used to link the broken edges and output continuous and smoothing edge contours of laser stripes. The results show that this method can output high-quality edge contours and is suitable in the edge detection of laser stripe located in microscope image.

articleTitle: The application of dimensional analysis in the design of sliding bearing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In this paper, a mathematical model for describing the stress and structural parameters of sliding bearing is established by dimensional analysis. First of all, a mathematical model is established, and the relevant parameters in the model are determined by orthogonal experiment. Then, the verification group is set up to verify the mathematical model. The results show that the model established by this method is accurate and reliable. The stress of sliding bearing is calculated using Ansys in different grid number, and the computing time is compared with the calculating time using the model mentioned above. The results show that using dimensional analysis method to build mathematical model can greatly shorten the calculating time. Therefore this method can be extended to the other bearing parameters calculation, which will greatly improve the design efficiency of sliding bearing.

articleTitle: An improved KFCM algorithm for unsupervised image segmentation based on neighborhood constraints
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Fuzzy clustering has been widely applied in the field of image segmentation, but it is sensitive for the noise in image. To solve this problem an unsupervised image segmentation improvement scheme combining neighborhood spatial constraints is proposed in this paper. The objective function of traditional fuzzy C-means clustering in the scheme are modified, and the kernel function and the neighbor spatial information are combined to improve the mode of action of the neighboring pixels on the center pixel, so that the center pixel of window can be adaptively updated through neighborhood pixel to achieve the purpose of filtering noise. The algorithm is applied and tested in synthetic and real images with salt and pepper noise and Gaussian noise, and the experimental results shown that compared with the other five traditional fuzzy C-means clustering and their improved schemes, the proposed algorithm is robust to noise, and the segmentation accuracy is significantly improved. In addition, the fuzzy clustering performance of the algorithm is also improved in the validity of the fuzzy division tested by three indicators.

articleTitle: Optimization of Shock Absorption Energy of Ship Based on Multi-Objective Cuckoo Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Energy optimization is one of the most important issues in ship stabilization in the recent ten years. Based on the nonlinear motion characteristics of the ship, a nonlinear model of ship rudder/fin combined with four degrees of freedom is established. In the meantime, this paper regards the additional energy consumption caused by various resistances and yaws as a new performance index of the combined rudder/fin system. In order to achieve the purpose of ship reduction, course maintenance and energy optimization, the self-tuning PID parameter is used to optimize the performance index based on the multi-objective cuckoo algorithm. In addition, the optimization model of multi-objective cuckoo algorithm is established by using random weight coefficient method, and the different objective functions are normalized to the same level by the normal method. The simulation results show that the control method based on multi-objective cuckoo algorithm compared with the ordinary multi-objective genetic algorithm, not only improves the efficiency of roll damping and heading control precision, but also optimizes the anti-rolling system energy consumption. The proposed method can achieve better performance under different sea conditions.

articleTitle: Algorithm for Automatic Generation of Sparse Image Array Based on View Morphing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The acquisition of sparse image array by the camera array is an important way to integrate imaging in the image acquisition phase. However, the camera array acquires a limited number of images and cannot meet the requirements of the application. This paper proposes a algorithm for automatic generation of sparse image array based on view morphing method by studying the relationship between the virtual viewpoint and the reference viewpoint. With this algorithm, we can estimate virtual viewpoint images at other locations in the sparse image array based on the reference viewpoint. Finally, the requirement to obtain a large number of sparse image array by capturing a reference image with a small number of camera arrays is achieved. This method can effectively increase the number of virtual viewpoint images in a sparse image array.

articleTitle: High Precision Laser Coding Method Based on Time Feedback
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The traditional laser coding has its disadvantages of poor accuracy and stability. In this work, a reference clock source that uses the precision timing function of the Global Positioning System (GPS) as a frequency hopping code is designed. A model of new coding sequence which is synthesized by dual pseudo-random sequence at the frequency trip point is constructed. Time-to-Digital Converter (TDC) technology is used to measure the pulse interval of the real-time generated coded signal to form real-time time feedback. Finally, the code is validated by software simulation and actual hardware operation. Experimental results show that this method can improve the anti-interference and coding accuracy of laser code.

articleTitle: The Design and Simulation of Transcranial Electrical Stimulation System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Transcranial electrical stimulation, as a widely used non-traumatic brain stimulation technology, has been widely used in medicine. At present, there are many types of electric stimulation devices on the market, but most of them are self-designed to achieve some certain simple therapeutic goals. This paper first introduce the design principles and requirements of transcranial electric stimulation system, and then design the signal generator part of the system. In order to meet the requirements of multi-mode stimulation, this paper designed a set of signal generator circuit which can generate the sine wave, square wave, sawtooth wave and a modulation waveform with the adjustable frequency. The signal generator, MAX038, can create a signal of different waveforms, which controlled by MCU, and the switching ADG1434 can achieve the conversion between different stimulus modes. The experimental results show that the signal generation system can output sine wave, pulse wave, sawtooth wave and modulated wave independently and control coupling output, so as to meet different therapeutic targets.

articleTitle: A Modified Johnson-Cook Model for Rotating Band Considering a Wide Range of Temperature
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In processing, the rotating band is subject to complex loading history and its property is different from annealed copper. The flow stress of rotating band is sensitive to temperature and strain rate. There is a mutation in 673K to 773K, and most of constitutive models don't take this phenomenon into consideration. In order to reveal the low of flow behaviors of metals, lots of researchers have carried out the thermo-mechanical experiments with wide range of temperature and strain rate. This paper shows three models compared with the experimental date and summarizes their difference. For a good fit result, a piecewise function of temperature is proposed to modify the Johnson-Cook model. At last, the fitting error is well controlled.

articleTitle: A Sneak Circuit Solution for CCD Aerial Camera's Main Backup System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This paper presents an airborne camera system. In order to ensure the reliability of the camera, the main backup design is adopted for the whole system except the CCD device. By analyzing the sneak circuit of the system, we find the sneak circuit of the system and propose a solution to eliminate the potential risk of the system. The design idea and the method of sneak circuit analysis are also feasible in the field of other similar imaging systems.

articleTitle: Design and Accomplishment of Traceability System of Agricultural Products
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: At present, the safety of agricultural products is increasingly serious [1]. In view of the current situation, based on RFID and related technologies, the traceability system of agricultural products was designed and implemented. After defining the overall framework of the system, the various parts of the system were designed in detail. The selection of the types of information to be collected and the design of the database under the traceability environment were discussed. Based on the designed system model, the system was implemented. The traceability system consists of a collection subsystem, a query subsystem, and a storage subsystem. The system integrates long-distance information transmission and storage and RFID tag data storage. It stores, traces and analyzes information on agricultural products such as picking, transportation, warehousing and retailing. It is reliable, practical, low cost and easy to deploy.

articleTitle: A Convenient Method to Solve Rotation Angle in 5-Axis Machine Tool Post-Processing
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In five-axis computer numerical control (CNC) machining, the tool axis vector is coordinated to the rotating coordinates by the post-processing. To solve the generated nonlinear error of the actual tool axis vector when the rotary axis is linearly interpolated, a convenient post-processing algorithm was proposed for the rotation angle of five-axis machine tools. A deviation model of the tool axis vector in 5-axis linear interpolation was proposed and the NC tool-paths were optimized by controlling the maximum allowable deviation range of the tool orientation vectors. By Visual Studio 2013, the post-processing algorithm was implemented for generating NC code. Modeling simulation and experiments were carried out on the “S” type specimen to verify the post-processing algorithm. The simulation results were analyzed which showed that the designed optimized tool paths were obviously better than the non-optimized tool paths.

articleTitle: Sidescan sonar image target extraction method based on variable initial signed distance function-based active contour CV model
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: UUV uses side scan sonar to perform search tasks. Due to the low contrast, blurring edges, color loss, and serious noise of sonar images, the UUV will produce noise gray values that are similar to the target and randomly distributed along the target and even cover the target. Due to the characteristics, the edge of the search target of the side scan sonar is blurred, and it is difficult to effectively detect and recognize it. The geometric active contour model is based on the curve evolution theory and the level set method. The curve evolution only depends on its inherent geometric characteristics. By implicitly representing the closed curve as the zero level set of the level set function in the high dimensional surface, the level set is used. The evolution of the function to obtain the evolution of the curve solves the problem of topological changes. This paper proposes a self-seeking method for level set initial contour curve. The CV model using global variables is used to extract the contours of sonar images, and the irregular blocky noises appearing in the vast majority of split sonar image objects are filtered out. Suppresses the possibility of irregular block noise around the target being segmented, and achieves the segmentation effect of the contour-fitting target, clear boundaries, and minimal noise.

articleTitle: Dynamic Modeling and Analysis of the Drill Stem in the Lunar Soil Drilling Sampler
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Mechanics researches related to the drill stem of the lunar soil drilling sampler mainly focus on the interaction characteristics between the drill stem and the soil at present, while the mechanical analysis of the drill stem itself is relatively less and can't reflect the actual working process. Aimed at this problem, it is presented in this paper that the flexible multibody dynamic model of the drill stem in the initial stage of drilling on lunar surface and the analysis results obtained by using the variable-length beam-shaft element. It turned out that to improve the drilling precision of the sampler, it is necessary to set up a special amplitude limiting mechanism between the rotating drive mechanism and the fixed support and lower the amplitude limiting mechanism in a suitable position to constitute an approximate clamped constraint with the fixed support to the drill stem. Works in this paper could provide theoretical basis for the design of amplitude limiting mechanism and raise the reliability of the lunar soil drilling sampler accordingly.

articleTitle: Automatic Application of LabVIEW on Electron Beam Analysis System
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Automation plays an important role in many instruments. In the past, the technology is not mastered by domestic manufacturers. So many large instruments in industry are imported from abroad and that leads to high costs. What's more, some instruments are complicated to operate and are not suitable for technicians. In this paper, a brand new LabVIEW-based system is established to measure the parameters of electron beams. It realizes the separation of hardware and software, so we can selectively purchase hardware and design software according to actual needs. To support the hardware system, LabViewVirtual Instrument Software Architecture (VISA) and Data Acquisition (DAQ) are applied to control the probe's sampling position and data acquisition. To validate the reliability of system, tests were done and satisfactory performance was manifested in test results.

articleTitle: The Research of the Liveness Detection Method Based on Sparse Support Vector Machines
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: With the development of face detection technology in identity authentication system, human face detection technology is becoming more and more important. It is very easy to use photographs and videos and other ways to get fake face to attack the identity authentication system. This paper designs a method on judging the authenticity of faces based on the texture feature difference between real face images and deception photos. The system is constructed by VC++ and OpenCV, mainly composed of image reading, face and facial features detection, image block feature extraction and classification of the support vector machine. In this paper, sparse support vector machine is used to train and classify data, and the application of sparse support vector machine in liveness detection is the innovation point of this paper. The results of experiments on a specific database show that it has good performance in terms of accuracy and speed.

articleTitle: The Effect of Visual Attention on Peripheral Stereopsis
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: We used a discrimination task to investigate the effect of stereo vision on eccentricity. The eccentricities were 15 arc deg, 30 arc deg, 35 arc deg, 42 arc deg and 50 arc deg. Participants distributed attention to locations indicated by a predictive cue. Attention areas were defined by a capital H. The participants must attention the direction that the cue indicated and reported the type of the targets-concave or convex. The results showed that the perception of stereopsis declined with the increasing eccentricities. Within the central 30 arc deg of the visual field, the stereopsis was clear. But beyond 30 arc deg of the visual field, specially beyond 42 arc deg, it was very hard to distinguish crossed disparities and uncrossed disparities.

articleTitle: A Starting Value Computation Method for Displacement Measurement Based on Magnetic Field
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Displacement measurement based on magnetic field has been exploited in motors and robots, however its measurement error is seriously affected by the measurement model accuracy. We have proposed a simultaneous computation of model parameters and displacement approach to improve measurement accuracy. While, in this approach, a starting value is needed at the initial measurement moment because of its iterative computation form. Traditional computation methods for starting value have a small convergence range or singularity problems, which limit their application. In this paper, a computational method, multi-parameter numerical continuous with wide convergence range, is presented for calculating starting value. This method combines the characteristics of traditional homotopy continuous and displacement measurement. Multiple parameters are introduced to form new homotopy equations. And then, the homotopy equations are solved according to the character of displacement solution. The simulation results verify that it has better convergence performance than tradition homotopy continuous method. Experimental results illustrate that the proposed method can compute a reasonable starting value for displacement solution to realize precision measurement based on magnetic field.

articleTitle: Estimation and Analysis of Multi-point Soil Moisture Based on Exponential Filtering
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: For the sake of making more rational use of soil temperature and humidity sensor to measure soil moisture in farmland, In this paper, by using the index filter method, we detect the soil surface humidity of the actual collection points to infer the deep soil humidity of other virtual collection points in the reasonable area. The experimental results show that for the virtual collection point (30-120cm) soil humidity, the estimation error of the exponential filtering method is within 2.85%-5.54%, and the estimation result in 30-60cm is the most accurate.

articleTitle: Research on the Circulating-Current Suppression of Parallel Inverters Based on Droop Control
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: As the interface of distributed generation and mi-cro-grid, the control performance of inverter is directly related to the performance of micro-grid. In this paper, the circulating-current of parallel inverters with the method of droop control is studied. After calculating the circulating-current with the equivalent impedance of the inverters and analyzing the influence of the difference between equivalent impedance on the cir-culating-current, a method of circulating-current suppression is proposed and presented. Through the simulation with the module in Matlab/Simulink and the implement with the parallel three-phase inverters platform, the correctness of the analysis and the feasibility and effectiveness of the proposed control strategy are verified.

articleTitle: Development of a Complete Multi-phase Dynamics Model for a Biped Robot
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Human walking is quite an efficient and smooth movement involving multiple successive phases. But for biped robots, most current dynamic walking models are simplified to some extent, with some phases neglected. This paper addresses the development of a complete multi-phase dynamics model for a biped robot. To achieve this, both the single support phase and double support phase are divided into two sub-phases by taking into consideration the rotation of stance foot around its toe and the rotation of swing foot around its heel. Therefore, a more human-like robotic gait is achieved, with transitions occurring at toe-off, heel-off, heel-strike, and toe-strike. Comparing the numbers of degrees of freedom with independent actuators of the biped robot, the whole gait cycle can also be represented by fully-actuated phase, under-actuated phase, and over-actuated phase. On this basis, the detailed dynamics model of each phase is derived using Euler-Lagrange method. And the validity of the dynamics model is demonstrated by simulation.

articleTitle: Implementation of Automatic Control System of Resistance Spot Welding for Square-Rectangular Steel Tube Packing Belt
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: In order to elevate the automation degree of square-rectangular steel tube packing and achieve better welding effect, a square-rectangular steel tube packing belt resistance spot welding automatic control system is designed based on OMRON CP1L in this paper. The resistance spot welding (RSW) machine and two axis servo motors are controlled by PLC. The touch screen is used to set the servo motion parameters and the welding parameters of resistance spot welding. According to the local circumstance, the form of single-side single spot welding is adopted by the system. The operation form of traditional manual arc welding is converted into automatic resistance spot welding system. The system can automatically invoke the corresponding welding parameters in the light of the specification of the steel tube packing. The practical application shows that the whole system is uncomplicated, stable, efficient and environmentally friendly compared with artificial arc welding. The utilization of the system not only enhances the welding efficiency, but also reduces the cost of human and environmental governance, so that the enterprise productivity efficiency has been greatly improved.

articleTitle: Ring Magnets Used for Improving the Vibration Response of a Micro Electromagnetic Energy Harvester
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: This work presents a new structure for improving the vibration response of a micro electromagnetic energy harvester. Compared with the primary structure, the new structure has additional ring magnets placed on the two ends of the device. This new mechanism helps to solve the problem of poor response. Two different structures with two ring magnets and four ring magnets are modeled and analyzed in this paper, respectively. As a result, the proposed structure with four ring magnets could effectively reduce the harmful cogging force and the resonant frequency, while not scarifying the available flux variation in the same displacement range.

articleTitle: Constructing Virtual Image for Navigational Fix Training Based on Digital Watermarking
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Virtual reality technology can construct the approximate nautical environment required for navigational fix training, which can not only make positioning teaching more intuitive and vivid, but also make trainees physically and psychologically immersed into training, thereby greatly improving the training quality. In this paper, a digital watermarking-based Image construction method for Navigational Fix training is proposed, with which the observational information will be embedded previously: the invisible watermark carrying the coordinate information is embedded in the video frame, and the observation value will be obtained after extracting the coordinate information in the observation picture. Using this method, the observation error caused by the projection distortion is bypassed, so that the accuracy of training feedback of multiple observation devices can be guaranteed. Thereby the overall system's accuracy requirements and construction difficulty is reduced.

articleTitle: Study on Sound Absorption of Perforated Plate
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The perforated plate sound absorber was proposed by professor Ma Dayou,a famous acoustics expert in China, in 1975, and a related theoretical model was established, which is called Ma's theory model. Perforated plate sound absorbers have been widely used in many fields such as buildings, ships, aircraft, mufflers and so on because of their advantages such as strong, light weight, corrosion resistance and environmental friendliness. It is regarded as the most attractive new generation of sound absorbing materials which can replace the traditional porous sound absorbing materials in the century. However, one significant disadvantages of traditional single layer perforated plate absorbers is that the sound absorption bandwidth is narrow, which is far from enough as a common sound absorption structure. Therefore, how to optimize and improve perforated plate absorber is a hot research topic at present. The sound absorption characteristics of perforated plate absorbers are determined by their structural parameters, such as perforation diameter, plate thickness, perforation rate and cavity depth.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Monitoring System of Greenhouse Intensity and CO2 Concentration Based on STM32
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Because the stability and accuracy of the traditional greenhouse monitoring system are not high enough, the light intensity and the grape canopy of the intelligent monitoring system are established for this phenomenon. It is based on the CO2 concentration of STM32 single chip to monitor the intensity of light and CO2 concentration and show it at the same time. Serial communication is used to send test results to MCGS touch screen to achieve real-time monitoring and warning of light intensity and CO2 concentration in greenhouse. The result of long term test shows the precision of the light intensity detection of the system is 9401ux, CO2 concentration measurement accuracy 40ppm. Compared with the traditional automatic monitoring system, the system runs stably and costs less, and the accuracy meets the requirements of grape greenhouse. In conclusion, the system proposed in this paper is suitable for agriculture.

articleTitle: Design and Tests of Muti-motors Hydromantic Position Control System of Primary Mirror Based on Large Telescope
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The primary mirror hydromantic position control system requires multi-motors and hydromantic components are controlled synchronously, and the control forces of different motors are changed with the position of primary mirror changing. At the same time, the control system also be required to support the mirror weight. According to the requirement of the hydromantic position control system of the large telescope. This paper provides a high integrated level control system based on open embedded controller and Ether cat technology, in order to control five different hydromantic Oil Volume Adjustment Component(OVAc)which is driven by five linear Actuator, constituting five permanent magnet synchronous motors and Roller screws. The whole control system including correction mode (CM), close-loop control using displacement sensors mode (CLDM), close-loop control using encoder position mode (CLCPM), close-loop control using encoder velocity mode (CLCVM), monitoring mode (MM), and halting mode (HM), in order to satisfy different working requirements. Position control strategy adopts three close-loop structures, including the inner current loop is PI controller with fiction compensation, the speed closed-loop is PI controller with two-order filter and the position closed-loop is P controller with Speed feed forward compensation in order to guarantee the accuracy of control system. Experiments are carried on the OVAC of 4m telescope and hydromantic position control system of 1.23m mirror. The results show that the accuracy of OVAC can achieve 1um when it bears 2700N load which equivalent each OVAC should bear of 4m mirror. At same time, the accuracy of 1.23m mirror at different pitch angle and different velocity can be always controlled less than 4.4um. This control system play an important role in the active optics correction, it can guarantee the image to stabilize one image unit in the field of view, so the control system meets the requirement the image accuracy.

articleTitle: Seal Performance Analysis of Hard Seal Ceramic Ball Valve
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: Due to high temperature, high pressure, strong corrosion and other adverse conditions, metal valves can easily cause seal failure and leak in coal chemical, petrochemical and other industries. This article mainly aims at the problem that the Ceramic ball valve is prone to seal failure, and expands research to the leakage of the valve. The material of the ball valve is Zirconia Ceramics. We have used Solid works to establish a simplified model of ball valve when the ball valve was closed, the opening of the valve was zero. We have used ANSYS Workbench calculate the seal pressure of the seal surface when the media pressure was OMPa, 5MPa, 10MPa, 15MPa and 20MPa. The maximum value of the equivalent stress is 325.23MPa and the maximum deformation is 0.15544mm when the media pressure is 20MPa. Under the condition of different media pressure, the upward trend of seal pressure is obtained by simulation and they all meet the conditions of seal. The minimum seal pressure at the seal surface is 1.1604MPa when the media pressure is OMPa. It shows that this hard seal Ceramic ball valve has good seal performance and no media leakage occurs.

articleTitle: Research on key structural parameters for multi-stage reciprocating compressor
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: The process of gas compression is very complex and difficult to study in multi-stage variable cross-section reciprocating compressor and how to determine key structure parameters is very important for its optimization design and improving performance. The mathematical model including check valve and gas leakage is firstly established based on working principle and motion characteristics. In the isothermal condition, the influence rules are studied between compression performance and structural parameters, which establishes the foundation for the design and application in multi-stage reciprocating compressor. The results show that the intake check valve and seal of high-pressure cylinder play an important role in the multistage reciprocating compressor and suitable design and selection for them can greatly improve the compressor performance.

articleTitle: A Method of Reducing Bus Transmission Errors of Stepping Motor Driver
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: To further achieve the uniform control mode of one leader with multi-followers of the stepping motor, the fieldbus method is adopted to control the stepping motor and its drive. In the aspect of communication, the RTU mode in Modbus protocol is used, the data are transmitted between upper computer and stepping motor via RS485 bus, and the communication is interrupted to detect the data error during communication. In practical test, the driver breakdown in the driver control system of stepping motor after data error transmission is effectively reduced.

articleTitle: Supertwisting Sliding Mode Repetitive Control under Periodic Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: A supertwisting sliding mode repetitive control method is proposed in this paper. It mainly focus on how to improve the system performance of supertwisting sliding mode control under periodic disturbance. By utilizing the advantages of both supertwisting sliding mode control and repetitive control, a method that combines them is presented. The system stability is proved. Simulation results in a hydraulic system demonstrate that the proposed method realize an accurate position tracking. At the same time, the gains in controller only need to be some small constants. Compare with adaptive-gain supertwisting sliding mode method, the gains would not need to increase continuously to deal with the disturbance, which make the proposed method have more applicability in practice.

articleTitle: An Electric-Hydraulic Propulsion System for the Urban Rail Train Energy Saving
publicationTitle: 2018 IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Automation (ICMA)
abstract: An electric-hydraulic propulsion system for the urban rail transit system is proposed. The double action hydraulic variable displacement pump/motor is utilized in the system. The hydraulic accumulator is employed to recover and release the regenerative braking energy. The results show that the system can save energy and ensure a great economic benefit.
